ETW traces: WinRM at an advanced level with 22 providers (UEX_WinRMAdvanced): WinRM, the remote shell, event forwarding and the event collector, WinHTTP and HTTP.sys, CAPI2, Kerberos, NTLM, CredSSP and Schannel; and WMI activity (UEX_WMIBase; before build 26063 also the WMI core and WMI_Tracing providers). TSS saves a task list at start and stop; on build 26063 or later it also runs a WMI arbitrator task dump (winmgmt /dumptasks arb) in a background job during the trace. At stop it runs scripts\WinRM-Collect.ps1 -Logs (WinRM configuration, listeners and plugins, WinRM-Diag.txt checks, dumps of the WinRM service, wsmprovhost, WecSvc and Windows Admin Center processes, 17 event logs including WinRM, CAPI2, PowerShell, Forwarding and EventCollector, event subscriptions, WinRM, HTTP, Schannel, LSA and CredSSP delegation registry keys, remote management group memberships, SPNs, certificates, netsh http settings, IIS configuration, firewall rules and gpresult) and scripts\Wmi-Collect.ps1 -Logs (dumps of the WMI service and provider hosts, WMI, OLE and RPC registry keys, the Application, System and WMI-Activity logs, provider and event subscription details and the WMI-RPC-DCOM-Diag.txt checks); each script may run up to 30 minutes. Tools: a netsh packet capture and Problem Steps Recorder (PSR) screenshots. The default basic log is skipped (noBasicLog).

scenarios.name: UEX_WMI
scenarios.description: Use when WMI queries fail or hang, a WMI provider crashes or misbehaves, WMI returns access denied or invalid namespace or class errors, or remote WMI over DCOM fails. ETW traces: WMI at an advanced level with the WMI core, WMI-Activity, WMI adapter, WMI_Tracing and client operations providers (UEX_WMIAdvanced), COM, DCOM, COM+, WinRT activation and RPC with 20 providers (UEX_COM), and a kernel trace in the NT Kernel Logger session (WIN_kernel; by default only process start and stop events, -ETWflags changes the kernel flags). TSS saves a task list at start and stop; on build 26063 or later it also runs a WMI arbitrator task dump (winmgmt /dumptasks arb) in a background job during the trace. With -EnableCOMDebug, TSS sets the OLE\Tracing ExecutablesToTrace=* registry value for COM debug logging; at stop that value is removed. At stop it runs scripts\Wmi-Collect.ps1 -Logs (up to 30 minutes: dumps of the WMI service and provider host processes, Autorecover MOFs, WMI, OLE and RPC registry keys, the Application, System and WMI-Activity logs, winmgmt service configuration, provider host, quota and event subscription details and the WMI-RPC-DCOM-Diag.txt checks) and scripts\COM-Collect.ps1 (msinfo32, COM, DCOM, COM+ and MSDTC registry and permissions, the COM+ application list, dumps of dllhost, RpcSs, DcomLaunch, WMI and EventSystem processes, Application and System logs, gpresult and the COM-COMPLUS-DCOM-Diag.txt checks). If WMI itself is not working, COM-Collect.ps1 waits for a Y/N answer before it continues. Tools: a netsh packet capture and Problem Steps Recorder (PSR) screenshots. The default basic log is skipped (noBasicLog).

scenarios.name: UEX_WMIHighCPU
scenarios.description: Use when WmiPrvSE.exe or the WMI service (the svchost hosting winmgmt) uses high CPU, to find which WMI provider, query or client process causes the load; capture while the high CPU is happening. ETW traces: WMI activity (UEX_WMIBase: WMI-Activity, and before build 26063 also the WMI core and WMI_Tracing providers) and a kernel trace in the NT Kernel Logger session (WIN_kernel; by default only process start and stop events, -ETWflags changes the kernel flags). TSS saves a task list at start and stop; on build 26063 or later it also runs a WMI arbitrator task dump (winmgmt /dumptasks arb) in a background job during the trace. At stop it runs scripts\Wmi-Collect.ps1 -Logs (up to 30 minutes): dumps of the WMI service, WmiPrvSE, decoupled provider, WmiApSrv and scrcons processes, Autorecover MOFs, the WBEM folder listing, WMI, OLE and RPC registry keys, the Application, System and WMI-Activity logs, winmgmt service configuration, the providers loaded in each WmiPrvSE host (ProviderHosts.txt), provider host quotas, permanent WMI event subscriptions and the WMI-RPC-DCOM-Diag.txt checks. Tools: a WPR trace with the CPU profile (GeneralProfile plus CPU sampling) and Problem Steps Recorder (PSR) screenshots. The default basic log is skipped (noBasicLog).

components.name: ADS_TEST
components.description: Test component for TSS developers: enables only the Kerberos ETW provider (6B510852-3583-4E2D-AFFE-A67F9F223438) under the name AdsTest; no additional data is collected. Not intended for customer data collection.

components.name: ADS_Basic
components.description: Broad authentication and logon ETW trace bundle. Enables tracing for the core Windows security stack in one switch: DPAPI (Data Protection), cryptography primitives, EFS (Encrypting File System), Kerberos, NTLM/CredSSP, the KDC (only produces data on a Domain Controller), SSL/TLS (Schannel), web authentication, smart card, NGC (Windows Hello / next-generation credentials), biometrics, and LSA. Use it when you do not yet know which authentication component is failing and want to capture everything at once.

components.name: ADS_Auth
components.description: Authentication-focused ETW trace bundle. Enables DPAPI, Kerberos, NTLM/CredSSP, SSL/TLS (Schannel), web authentication, smart card, NGC (Windows Hello), biometrics, LSA, and KDC providers together. Pick this when a sign-in, ticket, or credential problem is being reproduced and you want the full authentication picture without listing each sub-component individually.

components.name: ADS_AccountLockout
components.description: Account-lockout investigation trace. Enables Kerberos, NTLM/CredSSP, KDC, SSL/TLS, and LSA ETW providers and captures the Security event log so you can see which failed logon or bad-password attempt is locking an account. Run on the machine generating the lockout (a Domain Controller when KDC data is needed).

components.name: ADS_ADLDS
components.description: Traces AD LDS (Active Directory Lightweight Directory Services, formerly ADAM) - the standalone LDAP directory that runs without a full domain. ETW tracing captures LDAP and directory activity; static collection gathers each ADAM instance configuration, certutil output, dcdiag and ldifde exports, whoami, gpresult, and the AD LDS event logs.

components.name: ADS_ESR
components.description: Traces Enterprise State Roaming (ESR) - the feature that syncs user settings to the cloud on Entra/Azure-AD-joined devices. Bundles web authentication, ShellRoaming, CDP (Connected Devices Platform), WinHTTP, and SSL/TLS providers so you can follow a settings-sync problem from sign-in through the HTTPS call to the cloud.

components.name: ADS_ADDS
components.description: Traces core Active Directory Domain Services (the directory database and its APIs). ETW tracing captures directory and authentication activity; static collection gathers Kerberos tickets (klist), stored credentials (cmdkey), running tasks, the LSA/Netlogon/Winlogon/ProfSvc/Policies registry hives, policy definitions, and the adprep, dcpromo, netlogon and netsetup logs. Primarily used on Domain Controllers.

components.name: ADS_ADWS
components.description: Traces Active Directory Web Services (ADWS) - the service that lets the Active Directory PowerShell module and the AD Administrative Center talk to a Domain Controller. Collects the ADWS event log, ADWS registry settings, and ADWSlog.txt.

components.name: ADS_ADCS
components.description: Traces Active Directory Certificate Services (the Certification Authority role). ETW tracing captures certificate issuance and CA activity; static collection runs certutil (store, templates, registry), gathers the certsrv/certocm/certutil/certmmc logs, cryptography registry keys, klist, and a CertSvc service dump. Run on the CA server.

components.name: ADS_BadPwd
components.description: Finds where bad-password attempts are coming from. Runs the tss_FindUserBadPwdAttempts.ps1 script, which queries Domain Controllers for the source machine and time of a user's failed password attempts - the first step in tracking down an account-lockout or repeated logon-failure source.

components.name: ADS_Bio
components.description: Traces the Windows Biometric Framework (fingerprint and face sign-in). Part of the ADS_Basic and ADS_Auth bundles; enable on its own when Windows Hello biometric sign-in or enrollment is failing.

components.name: ADS_CAconfig
components.description: Collects a Certification Authority's configuration (no ETW tracing). Gathers msinfo32, the CertPropSvc and CA registry exports, certutil output (CA info, store, templates, CRL), and the Application/System/Security event logs - a quick health snapshot of a CA server.

components.name: ADS_CDP
components.description: Traces the Connected Devices Platform (CDP) - the component behind cross-device and cloud features such as Enterprise State Roaming and Phone Link. Usually enabled as part of ADS_ESR when a cloud-sync or device-pairing issue is being investigated.

components.name: ADS_CEPCES
components.description: Traces Certificate Enrollment Policy Web Service (CEP) and Certificate Enrollment Web Service (CES) - the roles that let clients enroll for certificates over HTTPS when they cannot reach the CA directly. Collects the environment details needed to diagnose web-based certificate enrollment.

components.name: ADS_CredprovAuthui
components.description: Traces credential providers and the logon UI (the tiles you click to sign in). Part of ADS_Basic and ADS_Auth; enable on its own when the sign-in screen, a third-party credential provider, or the password/PIN prompt is misbehaving.

components.name: ADS_CryptNcryptDpapi
components.description: Traces CryptoAPI, CNG (Cryptography Next Generation) and DPAPI (Data Protection API) - the plumbing that protects secrets such as saved passwords, certificates, and private keys. Part of ADS_Basic and ADS_Auth; enable when decrypting stored data or a certificate/private-key operation is failing.

components.name: ADS_CryptoPrimitives
components.description: Traces the low-level cryptographic primitives (hashing, signing, and encryption algorithms) used by the CNG providers. Part of ADS_Basic; enable together with ADS_CryptNcryptDpapi when a deep crypto-algorithm problem is suspected.

components.name: ADS_DFSR
components.description: Traces DFS Replication (the engine that keeps SYSVOL and other replicated folders in sync between servers). ETW tracing captures replication activity; static collection runs the DfsrInfo.ps1 script to gather DFSR configuration, backlog, and health details.

components.name: ADS_EFS
components.description: Traces the Encrypting File System (EFS) - per-file encryption tied to a user's certificate. Captures EFS ETW activity (add the -vAuth switch for more verbose NTFS traces), the EFS event logs, certutil output for the user and machine certificate stores, tasklist, and the EFS-related registry keys. Part of ADS_Basic.

components.name: ADS_FolderRedirection
components.description: Traces Folder Redirection - the Group Policy feature that points folders such as Documents or Desktop to a network share. Enable when redirected folders fail to apply, point to the wrong path, or are slow at logon (often analysed together with ADS_GPO and the profile components).

components.name: ADS_GPedit
components.description: Traces the Group Policy editor and client-side processing and collects GPedit.log from the debug usermode folder. Enable when authoring or applying a specific Group Policy setting fails.

components.name: ADS_GPmgmt
components.description: Traces the Group Policy Management Console (GPMC) and collects GPmgmt.log. Enable when managing GPOs - linking, backup, or modeling - fails inside the console.

components.name: ADS_GPO
components.description: Traces Group Policy processing - how a machine and user download and apply GPOs. Captures the Group Policy operational event log, the winlogon/User/Computer/Planning debug logs, the GPExtensions registry, and a gpresult report. The go-to component when a policy is not applying.

components.name: ADS_GPsvc
components.description: Traces the Group Policy Service (gpsvc) in depth. Turns on verbose GPsvc logging (GPsvc.log), collects the netlogon debug log, the GPsvc and Print registry keys, and the Group Policy event log. Use with ADS_GPO for hard-to-explain policy-processing failures.

components.name: ADS_IIS
components.description: Traces IIS (Internet Information Services) from the authentication angle - used when an AD-related web role such as certificate enrollment, ADFS, or OCSP depends on IIS. Enable together with the relevant PKI or web component.

components.name: ADS_KDC
components.description: Traces the Key Distribution Center (KDC) - the Domain Controller service that issues Kerberos tickets. Only produces data on a Domain Controller. Part of ADS_Basic, ADS_Auth and ADS_AccountLockout; enable on a DC when ticket issuance or authentication is failing.

components.name: ADS_Kerb
components.description: Traces the Kerberos authentication client (ticket requests, TGTs, and service tickets) on any machine. Part of ADS_Basic, ADS_Auth and ADS_AccountLockout. The primary component for 'Kerberos logon fails' or 'the user cannot access a service' problems.

components.name: ADS_LDAPcli
components.description: [-ProcessNames proc1.exe, svchost.exe] Traces LDAP client calls made by specific processes, so you can see which query an application sends to a Domain Controller. Specify the process names on the command line or in tss_config. Useful for finding an app that hammers a DC with expensive LDAP searches.

components.name: ADS_LDAPsrv
components.description: Traces the LDAP server (NTDSA) on a Domain Controller - the directory's query engine - and collects the related event log. Enable on a DC to diagnose slow or failing LDAP queries and inefficient search patterns.

components.name: ADS_LockOut
components.description: Runs the tss_GetLockoutEvents.ps1 script to gather account-lockout (event 4740) and related failed-logon events from the relevant Domain Controllers, helping pinpoint when and where an account is being locked.

components.name: ADS_LSA
components.description: Traces the Local Security Authority (LSA / lsass.exe) - the process that handles logon, tokens, and security policy. Part of ADS_Basic, ADS_Auth and ADS_AccountLockout; enable for deep authentication, token, or SSP (security package) problems.

components.name: ADS_NDES
components.description: Collects diagnostic logs and traces for Network Device Enrollment Service (NDES), including SCEP enrollment processing, Registration Authority (RA) operations, certificate request handling, IIS integration, and communication with the Certification Authority (CA). Enable when troubleshooting SCEP certificate enrollment, Intune certificate deployment, NDES policy module issues, or certificate issuance failures.

components.name: ADS_Netlogon
components.description: Traces the Netlogon service and collects its debug log (netlogon.log). Netlogon handles secure-channel setup between a member and its DC, DC locator, and pass-through authentication - enable when a machine cannot find or trust a Domain Controller.

components.name: ADS_NGC
components.description: Traces NGC (Next Generation Credentials) - the technology behind Windows Hello and Windows Hello for Business (PIN, biometric, and key-based sign-in). Part of ADS_Basic and ADS_Auth; enable when Hello enrollment or PIN/key sign-in fails.

components.name: ADS_NtLmCredSSP
components.description: Traces NTLM authentication and CredSSP (the provider used by Remote Desktop credential delegation). Part of ADS_Basic, ADS_Auth and ADS_AccountLockout; enable when legacy NTLM sign-ins or RDP credential delegation fail.

components.name: ADS_OCSP
components.description: Traces the Online Responder (OCSP) - the role that answers 'is this certificate revoked?' over HTTP. Turns on OCSP debug logging, collects the OCSP registry, OCSPsvc.log, and converts the captured OCSP.etl to text. Run on the OCSP server.

components.name: ADS_PAS
components.description: Domain Controller only. Collects Partial Attribute Set (PAS) comparison data: compares the schema PAS attribute count with the partial attribute set that every Global Catalog holds for each non-writable partition (repadmin /showattr <GC> /gc <NC> /atts:partialattributeset) and writes ADDS_PAS_Comparison.txt with rehost suggestions and manual-check commands. Use when Global Catalogs are missing attributes or a partition may need to be rehosted. No ETW tracing.

components.name: ADS_Perf
components.description: Collects Active Directory performance data by running the tss_ADPerfDataCollection.ps1 script, which offers a menu for common Domain Controller performance problems - High CPU, High Memory, High LSASS handle count, or Out of ATQ threads. Run on the affected Domain Controller.

components.name: ADS_Profile
components.description: Traces the User Profile Service (roaming and local profiles, folder load/unload). Collects the ProfSvc/GPO/Profile event logs, a gpresult report, profile load/unload timing, and roaming-profile settings. The main component for slow logon, temporary-profile, or roaming-profile issues.

components.name: ADS_SAMcli
components.description: Traces the SAM (Security Accounts Manager) client - the API used to read and manage local and domain accounts and groups. Enable when account or group lookups from a client are failing. Replaces the deprecated ADS_ADsam.

components.name: ADS_Schema
components.description: Traces and exports the Active Directory schema. Runs repadmin to show the Partial Attribute Set (PAS) and ldifde to dump the schema (Schema.ldf). Enable when investigating schema-extension or schema-replication problems.

components.name: ADS_ADsam
components.description: Deprecated - use ADS_SAMcli instead. Traces the SAM (Security Accounts Manager) client that reads and manages local and domain accounts and groups.

components.name: ADS_SAM
components.description: Deprecated - use ADS_SAMsrv instead. Traces the SAM (Security Accounts Manager) server component on a Domain Controller.

components.name: ADS_SAMsrv
components.description: Traces the SAM (Security Accounts Manager) server on a Domain Controller - the component that stores and serves account and group data. Enable on a DC when account or group operations fail server-side.

components.name: ADS_ShellRoaming
components.description: Traces Shell (Explorer) settings roaming used by Enterprise State Roaming. Part of ADS_ESR; enable when Start menu, taskbar, or other shell settings fail to sync across devices.

components.name: ADS_SmartCard
components.description: Traces smart card sign-in and the smart card subsystem (readers, certificates, and PIN). Part of ADS_Basic and ADS_Auth; enable when smart-card logon or reader detection fails.

components.name: ADS_SSL
components.description: Traces SSL/TLS (Schannel) - certificate negotiation and secure-channel setup for HTTPS, LDAPS, and RDP. Collects the CAPI2 operational event log and the TLS/WinHTTP/.NET registry settings. Enable for handshake failures, cipher or protocol mismatches, and certificate-trust errors.

components.name: ADS_UserInfo
components.description: Collects a snapshot of the current user's context: gpresult (/z and /v), whoami /UPN, klist cloud tickets, the user's certificate store (certutil), and dsregcmd device-join state. A quick way to see how a user is signed in and what policies and tokens they have.

components.name: ADS_WebAuth
components.description: Traces web-based authentication (the Web Account Manager and browser-based sign-in used for Entra ID and modern auth). Part of ADS_Basic, ADS_Auth and ADS_ESR; enable when a modern or cloud sign-in prompt or token request fails.

components.name: ADS_Appx
components.description: Traces AppX packaging and authentication as it relates to app identity and per-user app deployment. Enable when a packaged (Store/MSIX) app fails to install or run for reasons tied to user identity or licensing.

components.name: ADS_kernel
components.description: Deprecated - use WIN_kernel instead. Enables kernel ETW tracing.

components.name: ADS_WinHTTP
components.description: Traces WinHTTP - the HTTP client used by services (not the browser) for calls such as CRL/OCSP retrieval and cloud sync. Part of ADS_ESR; enable when a background HTTPS call from a service is failing or being blocked by a proxy.

components.name: ADS_W32Time
components.description: Traces the Windows Time service (w32time) and collects a full time-sync snapshot: w32tm status, stripchart, monitor and testif output, the W32Time registry and permissions, the W32Time event log, and scheduled tasks. Enable when clocks drift or Kerberos fails because time is out of sync.

components.name: ADS_WinLAPS
components.description: Traces Windows LAPS (Local Administrator Password Solution v2) - the feature that rotates and backs up the local admin password to AD or Entra ID. Collects the LAPS event log, the WinLAPS registry, LAPS module/binary file versions, and a gpresult report.

components.name: ADS_WUDFSc
components.description: Extends smart card tracing with the WUDFsc (User-Mode Driver Framework smart card) provider GUIDs. Enable together with ADS_SmartCard when a USB or UMDF smart card reader driver is involved.

components.name: CRM_IISdump
components.description: Collects a memory dump of the Dynamics CRM IIS application pool (CRMAppPool) when it crashes or hangs. Use to diagnose CRM web front-end crashes or hangs.

components.name: CRM_Platform
components.description: Traces the Dynamics CRM Platform (the server-side business logic). Enable to diagnose CRM platform errors and slow operations.

components.name: DEV_EESummitDemo
components.description: EE summit 2023 demo; do not use it for data collection

components.name: DEV_TEST1
components.description: Internal TSS test component (TEST1) - used to validate the framework, not for customer data collection.

components.name: DEV_TEST2
components.description: Internal TSS test component (TEST2) - used to validate the framework, not for customer data collection.

components.name: DEV_TEST3
components.description: Internal TSS test component (TEST3) - used to validate the framework, not for customer data collection.

components.name: DEV_TEST3Full
components.description: Internal TSS test component (TEST3Full) - used to validate the framework, not for customer data collection.

components.name: DEV_TEST4
components.description: Internal TSS test component (TEST4) - used to validate the framework, not for customer data collection.

components.name: DEV_TEST5
components.description: Internal TSS test component (TEST5) - used to validate the framework, not for customer data collection.

components.name: DND_Audio
components.description: Traces the Windows audio stack (drivers, endpoints, audio service) and collects audio driver info, endpoints, registry, and audio service logs. Enable when sound playback or recording fails.

components.name: DND_CBS
components.description: Traces Component-Based Servicing (CBS) - the engine that installs and removes Windows components and updates - and collects package state and the CBS logs. Part of DND_Servicing; enable when a Windows update or optional feature fails to install.

components.name: DND_CodeIntegrity
components.description: Traces Code Integrity - the driver and kernel signing enforcement behind Memory Integrity (HVCI) and WDAC. Enable when a driver or app is blocked by a code-integrity policy.

components.name: DND_PNP
components.description: Traces Plug and Play (PnP) device enumeration and driver installation and collects pnputil driver info. Part of DND_Servicing; enable when a device fails to install or start.

components.name: DND_Power
components.description: Traces power management and collects battery, sleep-study, and energy reports plus power settings (powercfg). Enable for battery, sleep/resume, or power-plan problems.

components.name: DND_SAReport
components.description: Collects a Subscription Activation (SA) troubleshooting report - checks Windows edition, licensing diagnostics, dsregcmd device state, and the Store and Azure AD logs. Enable when Windows subscription activation (for example an E3/E5 step-up) fails.

components.name: DND_SETUP
components.description: Collects a comprehensive Setup / deployment and Windows Update dataset (setup, upgrade, servicing, DISM, and Update logs) - no live ETW tracing. Use for OS install or feature-update failures.

components.name: DND_SETUPreport
components.description: Collects a detailed setup / deployment report with selectable phases: system info, DISM, disk, BitLocker, license, services, registry hives, event logs, setup, Windows Update, USO and Delivery Optimization (DO), and upgrade data - no live ETW tracing.

components.name: DND_Servicing
components.description: Traces Windows servicing broadly (CBS, PnP, and Windows Update together) and collects msinfo32, system info, and CBS/PnP data. The go-to component for update or component-install failures.

components.name: DND_TPM
components.description: Collects Trusted Platform Module (TPM) diagnostics: TPM status, BitLocker configuration, attestation, and secure-boot info (msinfo32, whoami, system info). Enable for TPM, BitLocker, or attestation problems.

components.name: DND_USB
components.description: Traces the USB stack and collects device enumeration, driver info, USB registry, and USB event logs. Enable when USB devices fail to enumerate or work.

components.name: DND_WU
components.description: Traces Windows Update (including the USO/usosvc Update Orchestrator Service) and collects update history, pending updates, CBS/DISM logs, WSUS and Delivery Optimization (DO) config, and the Windows Update log. Part of DND_Servicing; enable when updates fail to download or install.

components.name: DND_WUfBReport
components.description: Collects a Windows Update for Business (WUfB) report: the DataCollection/DiagTrack registry, scheduled tasks, dsregcmd device state, and diagtrack version info. Enable when enterprise-managed updates are not applying as configured.

components.name: INT_MSMQ
components.description: Traces MSMQ (Message Queuing) as used by BizTalk and other integration services. Enable when messages fail to queue, route, or deliver.

components.name: MCM_Report
components.description: Collects a Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) client report - client logs, configuration, and status. Enable to diagnose ConfigMgr client health, policy, or deployment problems.

components.name: NET_802Dot1x
components.description: Wired LAN 802.1x (dot3) authentication scenario tracing (use only with -Scenario NET_802Dot1x)

components.name: NET_AfdTcpBasic
components.description: Afd/TcpIp/NetIO basic component ETW tracing (includes TCP rundown at start/stop)

components.name: NET_AfdTcpFull
components.description: Afd/TcpIp/NetIO full component ETW tracing (includes TCP rundown at start/stop and TCP/UDP port-exhaustion check at stop)

components.name: NET_BFE
components.description: Base Filtering Engine (BFE) component ETW tracing and BFE service/registry (ACL) permissions collection

components.name: NET_BGP
components.description: Traces Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) routing on Windows (used by RRAS and SDN). Enable when BGP peering or route advertisement fails.

components.name: NET_BITS
components.description: Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) component ETW tracing; also collects bitsadmin job/peer info, BITS registry, Bits-Client/Operational event log and HTTP URL ACLs. Use -Mode Restart (or global BITSLOG_RESTART) to enable verbose BITS.log

components.name: NET_Bluetooth
components.description: Bluetooth component ETW tracing; enables BTHUSB/BTHPort VerboseOn and Simple Pairing debug, collects Bluetooth radio info (tss_GetBluetoothRadioInfo.ps1), registry and Bluetooth event logs

components.name: NET_BranchCache
components.description: BranchCache component ETW tracing; collects BranchCache config (netsh BranchCache / Get-BC* cmdlets), PeerDist store info, registry, event logs and certs; restarts PeerdistSvc unless -noRestart

components.name: NET_CAPI
components.description: Traces CryptoAPI 2 (CAPI2) - certificate chain building and revocation checking. Enable for certificate validation, trust, or revocation errors (works well with a network capture and ADS_SSL).

components.name: NET_COM
components.description: COM/DCOM/WinRT/RPC component tracing. -EnableCOMDebug will enable further debug logging

components.name: NET_Container
components.description: Traces Windows containers, Docker, and the Host Networking Service (HNS). Collects HNS network/endpoint info, firewall rules and profiles, WFP state, and a docker or kubectl inventory. Use -Mode <Docker|Kube> to target the platform. Enable for container networking problems.

components.name: NET_CSC
components.description: Client Side Caching (CSC) tracing (to be used only as -Scenario NET_CSC, or as -CollectLog NET_CSC, not as a component)

components.name: NET_DAcli
components.description: Direct Access client component ETW tracing; runs tss_DAclient-collector.ps1, collects DA/NCSI/IPv6 client config (PowerShell), WFP state and event logs

components.name: NET_DAmgmt
components.description: Traces DirectAccess management (configuration and monitoring). Enable when the DirectAccess management console or Remote Access setup fails (usually together with NET_DAsrv).

components.name: NET_DAsrv
components.description: Direct Access server component ETW tracing; collects netsh ras dump, IP-HTTPS state, DA server info (Get-DAServer/Get-RemoteAccess*), WFP state, TLS/WinHTTP registry and event logs

components.name: NET_DCLocator
components.description: Traces the DC Locator - how a client finds a Domain Controller (via DNS and Netlogon). Enable when a machine picks the wrong DC or cannot locate one.

components.name: NET_DFSmgmt
components.description: DFS Management (DFSmgmt) console tracing; swaps Dfsmgmt.dll.config to enable tracing and collects DfsMgmt.current.log (all MMC consoles must be closed before repro)

components.name: NET_DFSn
components.description: DFS-N (namespace) component ETW tracing (included in NET_SMBsrv)

components.name: NET_DFSsrv
components.description: DFS-N (namespace) server component ETW tracing; collects DFS/RPC registry, DFS event logs and DFS server info. Run 'DFSdiag.exe' checks separately via -StartDiag NET_DFSn

components.name: NET_DHCPcli
components.description: DHCP client component ETW tracing; collects DHCP lease info, DHCPcli/Tcp registry, WFP state and DHCP-Client event logs

components.name: NET_DHCPsrv
components.description: DHCP server component ETW tracing; collects 'netsh dhcp server show' and Get-DhcpServer* config, DHCP database and audit logs, folder permissions (AccessChk) and event logs

components.name: NET_dns
components.description: DNS client API (dnsapi) and DNS WPP tracing. Sub-component of NET_SMBcli - normally enable NET_SMBcli instead. Use alone only to narrow tracing to name resolution.

components.name: NET_DNScli
components.description: DNS client component ETW tracing; collects Get-DnsClient* config, 'netsh dnsclient show state', Auth/Crypt/TLS/WinHTTP registry and DNS-Client/Operational event log

components.name: NET_DNSsrv
components.description: DNS server component ETW tracing; collects Dnscmd and Get-DnsServer* config/statistics, DNS server zone/policy registry hive, DNS *.log files and event logs; can be used with -Mode Verbose

components.name: NET_Firewall
components.description: Windows Defender Firewall component ETW tracing; enables advfirewall connection logging and Filtering-Platform packet-drop/connection auditing, collects firewall rules (Get-NetFirewall*), pfirewall.log, WFP state, BFE registry permissions and Security event log. To find which WFP filter allows or blocks a specific IP and port, run -StartDiag NET_WFPAnalyzer.

components.name: NET_FltMgr
components.description: Traces the Filter Manager (fltmgr) - the framework that hosts file-system minifilters such as antivirus and encryption. Enable when a minifilter is suspected of blocking or slowing file I/O.

components.name: NET_fr
components.description: Folder Redirection (fr) and User State Technologies common (UstCommon) WPP tracing. Sub-component of NET_SMBcli - normally enable NET_SMBcli instead. Use alone only to trace Folder Redirection of user folders to a file share.

components.name: NET_fskm
components.description: SMB client kernel-mode stack tracing: Remote FileSystem log (MUP, DFS client, RDBSS, CSC, WebDAV), RDBSS, MRxSMB/SMB2 client, Witness client, BranchCache (peerdist), Offline Files service and NFS redirector. Sub-component of NET_SMBcli - normally enable NET_SMBcli instead.

components.name: NET_FSRM
components.description: Traces File Server Resource Manager (FSRM) from the networking angle - quotas, file screens, and classification on file shares. Enable when FSRM policies affect share access.

components.name: NET_fsum
components.description: SMB client user-mode tracing: Offline Files / Client-Side Caching (cscnet, cscdll, cscapi, cscui, cscum), WebDAV client (WebClnt) and the TCP/IP NetBIOS helper (LmhSvc). Sub-component of NET_SMBcli - normally enable NET_SMBcli instead.

components.name: NET_FWmgr
components.description: Traces the Windows Firewall management interface (rules and profiles). Enable when firewall rules fail to apply or the firewall service misbehaves (usually together with NET_Firewall).

components.name: NET_HNS
components.description: Traces the Host Networking Service (HNS) - the service that manages container and Kubernetes virtual networks and endpoints. Enable for Windows container networking problems (usually together with NET_Container).

components.name: NET_HTTP
components.description: Traces the WinINet and WinHTTP HTTP client stacks. Enable when applications or services fail to make HTTP/HTTPS connections (often through a proxy).

components.name: NET_HttpSys
components.description: WinInet/HttpSys component ETW tracing; collects CAPI2/Operational event log and HTTP URL ACLs (netsh http show urlacl)

components.name: NET_HypVM
components.description: Traces Hyper-V virtual-machine networking (synthetic NIC, netvsc, vmbus) and collects the Hyper-V-NETVSC/Diagnostic event log. Enable inside a VM for guest network problems.

components.name: NET_ICS
components.description: Internet Connection Sharing (ICS) / SharedAccess-NAT component ETW tracing; collects ICS registry

components.name: NET_IIS
components.description: Traces IIS (Internet Information Services) and collects the HTTPERR and inetpub logs, netsh http config, appcmd site/app-pool/app config, and HTTP/TLS/WinHTTP registry. Enable for IIS web server problems.

components.name: NET_IPAM
components.description: IP Address Management (IPAM) component ETW tracing; enables IPAM debug logging registry keys, collects IPAM .svclog files, converts IPAM.etl and gathers IPAM event logs (do not leave logging enabled long-term)

components.name: NET_IPhlpSvc
components.description: IPhelper Service (IpHlpSvc) component ETW tracing; enables IpHlpSvc file tracing and collects the resulting %windir%\tracing logs

components.name: NET_IPsec
components.description: IPsec component ETW tracing; enables IPsec/Filtering-Platform security auditing, collects IPsec rules (netsh advfirewall/ipsec and Get-NetIPsec* cmdlets) and Security event log

components.name: NET_KernelIO
components.description: Traces kernel I/O activity. A low-level helper used with other components to correlate network operations with kernel I/O.

components.name: NET_LBFO
components.description: Load Balancing/Failover (LBFO NIC Teaming) and NDIS component ETW tracing; collects LBFO registry and certificate info

components.name: NET_LDAPsrv
components.description: Active Directory LDAP server (NTDSA) ETW tracing on a Domain Controller with all keywords at maximum level. Run it on the DC that serves the client to see how LDAP binds, searches and modifications are processed.

components.name: NET_LLDP
components.description: Link-Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) component ETW tracing; also collects LLDP/Operational event log

components.name: NET_LLTDIO
components.description: Link-Layer Topology Discovery Mapper I/O (LLTDIO) driver component ETW tracing; also collects 'GPresult /Z'

components.name: NET_MBAM
components.description: Traces the Microsoft BitLocker Administration and Monitoring (MBAM) client. Enable when BitLocker key escrow or compliance reporting to MBAM fails.

components.name: NET_MBN
components.description: Mobile Broadband (MBN) and Wireless Wide Area Network (WWAN) component ETW tracing; enables netsh MBN tracing, collects MBN interface/profile info, WwanSvc profiles, WMI logs, netcfg, 802Dot1x/MBN/TCP/TLS registry and event logs

components.name: NET_MDM
components.description: Mobile Device Management (MDM) component ETW tracing; runs MdmDiagnosticsTool, collects MDM registry and DeviceManagement event logs

components.name: NET_MFAext
components.description: Traces the NPS Multi-Factor Authentication extension (MFAext). Enables AzureMfa verbose logging, restarts the NPS/IAS service (unless -noRestart), and collects the MFAext registry and the System and NPS event logs. Enable when Azure MFA on NPS/RADIUS fails.

components.name: NET_Miracast
components.description: Traces Miracast wireless display (screen projection over Wi-Fi Direct). Enable when projecting to a wireless display fails (usually via the NET_Miracast scenario).

components.name: NET_MUX
components.description: Traces the SDN Software Load Balancer multiplexer (MUX). Enable when load-balanced traffic distribution misbehaves in a Software Defined Networking fabric.

components.name: NET_nbt
components.description: NetBIOS over TCP/IP (NetBT) driver tracing. Sub-component of NET_SMBcli - normally enable NET_SMBcli instead. Use alone for NetBIOS name resolution or port 139 session issues.

components.name: NET_NCA
components.description: Traces the Network Connectivity Assistant (NCA) - the DirectAccess client status and UI. Enable when the DirectAccess connectivity indicator is wrong (usually together with NET_DAcli).

components.name: NET_NCHA
components.description: Traces the Network Controller Host Agent (NCHA) - the agent on a host that applies SDN policy. Enable for Software Defined Networking policy problems on a host.

components.name: NET_NCSI
components.description: Network Connectivity Status Indicator (NCSI/NLA) component ETW tracing, prefer using -Scenario NET_NCSI

components.name: NET_NDIS
components.description: Traces NDIS (Network Driver Interface Specification) - the layer between network adapters and the TCP/IP stack. Enable for low-level adapter, miniport, or packet-path problems (used by many NET scenarios).

components.name: NET_NDIScap
components.description: Traces the NDIS packet-capture ETW provider (Microsoft-Windows-NDIS-PacketCapture), i.e. the packet capture engine that netsh trace uses, as a component ETW trace. Honors -EtlOptions; for a regular packet capture use -Netsh.

components.name: NET_NDISwan
components.description: Traces NDISWAN - the layer that presents dial-up and VPN links as network adapters. Enable for RAS/VPN link-level problems.

components.name: NET_Netlogon
components.description: Netlogon component ETW tracing; enables Netlogon service debug log (DbFlag) and collects %windir%\debug (netlogon.log)

components.name: NET_NetProfM
components.description: Network Profile Manager (network list service) component ETW tracing. Is not working with -StartAutoLogger mode

components.name: NET_Netsetup
components.description: NetSetup component ETW tracing; collects %windir%\logs\NetSetup logs

components.name: NET_NetworkUX
components.description: Traces the network user experience (the network flyout and connect/disconnect UI). Enable when the network list or connect UI misbehaves.

components.name: NET_NFC
components.description: Traces Near Field Communication (NFC). Enable when NFC tap or proximity features fail.

components.name: NET_NFScli
components.description: Network File System (NFS) client component ETW tracing; collects NFS client config (nfsadmin/Get-NfsClientConfiguration/mount), NFS mapped identities, NFS/NFScli registry and event logs

components.name: NET_NFSsrv
components.description: Network File System (NFS) server component ETW tracing; sets LogActivity=All, collects NFS server config, shares/permissions, mapped identities, clients, sessions and statistics (nfsadmin/showmount/Get-Nfs* cmdlets) and event logs; add '-Mode Permission' to collect NFS/NTFS permissions

components.name: NET_NLB
components.description: Network Load Balancing (NLB) component ETW tracing; collects Afd/TcpIp/NetIO/NLB providers, WLBS display, ARP table, msinfo32, WLBS registry and NLB/Diagnostic event log

components.name: NET_NPS
components.description: Network Policy Server (NPS) incl. EapHost component ETW tracing; enables 'netsh nps set tracing verbose', exports NPS config/settings, collects %windir%\System32\LogFiles\NPS, NPS/RAS/LDAP/TLS registry, certs and Security event log

components.name: NET_OLE32
components.description: Traces OLE32 / COM marshaling from the networking angle. Enable together with NET_RPC to follow DCOM calls over the network.

components.name: NET_OpenSSH
components.description: OpenSSH component ETW tracing; collects sshd_config/ssh config files, administrators_authorized_keys and permissions, sshd/ssh-agent service info, OpenSSH registry and event logs

components.name: NET_Outlook
components.description: Outlook component ETW tracing; sets Outlook EnableLogging/EnableETWLogging registry (requires manual Outlook restart) and collects the %temp%\Outlook Logging folder

components.name: NET_PCI
components.description: Collects PCI and driver inventory at stop: PCI registry, setupapi and PCI logs, msinfo32 (.nfo), network adapter info, Get-Hotfix, and file-version lists of System32 drivers and binaries. Recommended as -CollectLog NET_PCI.

components.name: NET_PortProxy
components.description: PortProxy (IpHlpSvc) component ETW tracing; collects PortProxy registry and 'netsh interface portproxy show all'

components.name: NET_Proxy
components.description: Proxy tracing (AfdTcpBasic, NCSI, NDIS, WebIO, Winsock)

components.name: NET_QoS
components.description: Quality of Service (QoS/qWAVE/Pacer) component ETW tracing; collects Get-NetQosPolicy, QoS registry and QoS event logs

components.name: NET_Quic
components.description: Traces the Microsoft QUIC (MsQuic) transport - the UDP-based protocol behind HTTP/3 and SMB over QUIC. Enable for QUIC connection or performance problems.

components.name: NET_RadioManager
components.description: Traces the Radio Manager - airplane mode and radio (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/cellular) on/off state. Enable when radios fail to enable or disable (used by the wireless scenarios).

components.name: NET_RAmgmt
components.description: RemoteAccess management (RaMgmtSvc) component ETW tracing; enables RaMgmtSvc DebugFlag/EnableTracing (may prompt to restart RaMgmtSvc), converts and collects %windir%\tracing\RaMgmtSvc logs

components.name: NET_RAS
components.description: Remote Access Server (RAS) component ETW tracing; collects IP routing filters, 'netsh ras dump', AlwaysOn VPN Get-VpnAuthProtocol, RAS/LDAP/TLS registry, certs and RAS event logs

components.name: NET_RasMan
components.description: Traces the Remote Access Connection Manager (RasMan) service - the service that manages VPN and dial-up connections. Enable when VPN connections fail to start or be managed.

components.name: NET_RDMA
components.description: Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) component ETW tracing; collects 'netstat -xan' RDMA connection info

components.name: NET_RNDIS
components.description: Traces Remote NDIS (RNDIS) - USB and tethering devices that present as network adapters. Enable when a USB-tethered or RNDIS device fails to network.

components.name: NET_RPC
components.description: RPC (Remote Procedure Call), RpcSs and DCOM component ETW tracing; collects RPC registry and (non-Lite) RPCcfg.exe/RPCdump.exe output

components.name: NET_rpcxdr
components.description: ONC RPC / XDR (rpcxdr) tracing used by NFS. Sub-component of NET_SMBcli - normally enable NET_SMBcli instead. Also relevant for NFS client issues.

components.name: NET_SCCM
components.description: Enables Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) client global debug logging and collects the client logs folder (%windir%\CCM\Logs). Enable for ConfigMgr client-side problems.

components.name: NET_SdnNC
components.description: Deprecated: Please use SdnDiagnostics tools at https://www.powershellgallery.com/packages/SdnDiagnostics

components.name: NET_sec
components.description: Traces the security provider (Schannel/SSPI) from the networking angle. A helper for following authentication and TLS within network traces.

components.name: NET_SMB
components.description: Traces the SMB client and server together. Enable for file-sharing problems where both ends are on the same machine (usually via the NET_SMB scenario).

components.name: NET_SmbCA
components.description: Traces SMB Direct (SMB over RDMA) - high-speed storage networking. Enable for SMB Direct connectivity or performance problems (usually together with NET_RDMA).

components.name: NET_SMBcli
components.description: SMB client component ETW tracing (dns, fr, fskm, fsum, rpcxdr, sec, tcp, Quic providers); also collects CSC/RPC/SMB/TCP/LSA registry, UNC hardening settings, SMB client event logs, GPresult and certs

components.name: NET_SMBcluster
components.description: Traces the clustered SMB server components (csvfs, csvflt, csvvbus, csvnflt). Enable for Scale-Out File Server or Cluster Shared Volume SMB problems.

components.name: NET_smbhash
components.description: SMB hash generation (smbhash, BranchCache content information for SMB file servers) tracing. Sub-component of NET_SMBsrv - normally enable NET_SMBsrv instead.

components.name: NET_SMBsrv
components.description: SMB server component ETW tracing (srv, smbhash, sr, DFSn, NFSsrv, sec, Quic providers); also collects SMB server registry, LanmanServer bindings check, open files, share/NTFS permissions (AccessChk), event logs and GPresult. Add '-Mode Permission' to collect share/file permissions

components.name: NET_SMBsrvBinding
components.description: CollectLog only (-CollectLog NET_SMBsrvBinding): lists the SMB server (LanmanServer) protocol bindings from the Linkage\Bind registry value, including the TCP/IPv4 and TCP/IPv6 bindings (_SvrBindings.txt).

components.name: NET_SNMP
components.description: SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol) agent component ETW tracing; collects SNMP registry

components.name: NET_SQLcheck
components.description: CollectLog only (-CollectLog NET_SQLcheck): runs SQLCheck.exe (CSS SQL Networking Tools) and saves the SQL Server / client connectivity settings report as SQLCHECK.log. Skipped in TSS Lite.

components.name: NET_sr
components.description: Storage Replica (Windows Volume Replication: wvrf filter driver, service and CIM provider) tracing. Sub-component of NET_SMBsrv - normally enable NET_SMBsrv instead.

components.name: NET_srv
components.description: SMB server stack tracing: srv (SMB1), srv2, srvnet, Server service (srvsvc), resume-key filter (continuously available handles), Witness service and the SMB WMI provider. Sub-component of NET_SMBsrv - normally enable NET_SMBsrv instead.

components.name: NET_SSTP
components.description: Traces the Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) - VPN over HTTPS. Enable when an SSTP VPN connection fails.

components.name: NET_TAPI
components.description: Telephony API (TAPI) component ETW tracing; collects %windir%\tracing TAPI logs

components.name: NET_tcp
components.recommended: NET_SMBcli; Scenario NET_SMB; Scenario NET_SMBcli; Scenario NET_NFScli
components.description: Legacy TCP/IP WPP trace (tcp provider, limited keywords). Sub-component of NET_SMBcli - normally enable NET_SMBcli instead. For TCP/IP problems use NET_AfdTcpBasic or NET_AfdTcpFull instead.

components.name: NET_TestMe
components.description: NET TestMe tracing - for Testing purpose only

components.name: NET_VMswitch
components.description: Traces the Hyper-V virtual switch (vmswitch) - how VM traffic is forwarded. Enable for VM connectivity, VLAN, or virtual-switch problems on a Hyper-V host.

components.name: NET_VPN
components.description: Virtual Private Network (VPN) component ETW tracing; collects VPN profiles (tss_ExportVPNProfiles.ps1 in user and SYSTEM context), machine/user .pbk profiles, AlwaysOn VPN Get-VpnConnection info, Credential Guard state, Azure VPN logs, VPN registry, CAPI2/Operational and VPN event logs

components.name: NET_WCM
components.description: Traces the Windows Connection Manager (WCM) - the service that decides which network to use and enforces connection policies. Enable for automatic-connection or metered/cost-network problems.

components.name: NET_WebClient
components.description: WebClient with SMBcli tracing. To restart service use -Mode Restart

components.name: NET_WebIO
components.description: WebIO/WinHTTP/WinInet component ETW tracing; collects proxy info, HTTP URL ACLs and WebIO analytic event logs

components.name: NET_WFP
components.description: Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) and BFE component ETW tracing; collects 'netsh wfp show' state/filters/netevents/boottimepolicy, firewall logs and the WFP/Operational event log. Note: this component does NOT run WFPdiag - add the '-WFPdiag' switch to also collect a WFP diagnostics trace. To find which WFP filter allows or blocks a specific IP and port, run -StartDiag NET_WFPAnalyzer.

components.name: NET_WinInet
components.description: Traces WinINet - the HTTP/FTP client used by Internet Explorer and many apps (cookies, cache, proxy). Enable for browser or app HTTP problems tied to WinINet.

components.name: NET_Winlogon
components.description: Traces Winlogon from the networking angle (network provider order and credential handling at logon). Enable for network-related sign-in problems.

components.name: NET_WinNAT
components.description: Traces Windows NAT (WinNAT) - the network address translation used by containers, Hyper-V internal switches, and Internet Connection Sharing. Enable for container or NAT connectivity problems.

components.name: NET_Winsock
components.description: Traces Winsock - the Windows Sockets API, including Layered Service Providers (LSPs). Enable when apps fail to open sockets or a third-party LSP interferes.

components.name: NET_WIP
components.description: Traces Windows Information Protection (WIP / enterprise data protection). Enable when WIP policy blocks or misclassifies network access to work data.

components.name: NET_Wlan
components.description: Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) component ETW tracing. DO NOT USE this alone, just as an addition to either NET_WLAN or NET_802Dot1x scenario if you need additional logging

components.name: NET_WmbClass
components.description: Traces the WmbClass driver - the mobile broadband (WWAN) class driver for cellular modems. Enable for cellular/WWAN device problems (usually together with NET_MBN).

components.name: NET_WNV
components.description: Traces Windows Network Virtualization (WNV / HNV) - the overlay networking behind SDN. Enable for Software Defined Networking overlay problems.

components.name: NET_Workfolders
components.description: Traces Work Folders - the sync of work files to a file server over HTTPS. Enable when Work Folders fail to sync (usually via the NET_WorkFolders scenario).

components.name: NET_WSman
components.description: Traces WS-Management (WSMan) - the protocol behind WinRM and PowerShell remoting. Enable for remote-management connection problems (often together with UEX_WinRM).

components.name: NET_WWAN
components.description: Traces the WWAN service (mobile broadband / cellular). Same area as NET_MBN; enable for cellular connectivity problems.

components.name: PRF_Alarm
components.description: Traces the Alarms & Clock app. Enable when that app fails to launch or work.

components.name: PRF_AppX
components.description: Traces the AppX deployment stack (Store/MSIX app install and packaging) and collects the AppX event logs and the AppX/AppModel/StateRepository registry. The base component used by most PRF app scenarios; enable when packaged apps fail to install, update, or start.

components.name: PRF_Boot
components.description: Boot-performance capture. Use with -StartAutoLogger -Scenario PRF_Boot so the trace starts early during the next boot. Combines LSA, credential-provider, logon, shell, and Service Control Manager tracing with a WPR boot trace to diagnose slow startup and sign-in.

components.name: PRF_Calc
components.description: Traces the Calculator app. Enable when Calculator fails to launch or work.

components.name: PRF_Camera
components.description: Traces the Camera app and camera pipeline. Enable when the camera fails to start or capture.

components.name: PRF_ClipBoard
components.description: Traces the clipboard, including cloud clipboard and clipboard history. Enable when copy/paste or clipboard history fails.

components.name: PRF_Cortana
components.description: Traces the Cortana app. Enable when Cortana fails to launch or respond.

components.name: PRF_DM
components.description: Traces device management (the MDM InstallService, Enterprise Management, and CSPs). Enable when MDM/Intune policies fail to apply on the client (deep MDM enrollment issues use the INTUNE POD).

components.name: PRF_DWM
components.description: Traces the Desktop Window Manager (dwm.exe) - the compositor that draws the desktop. Enable for visual glitches, flicker, or compositor crashes.

components.name: PRF_Font
components.description: Traces the font subsystem and collects the font-related registry. Enable when fonts render incorrectly or fail to install.

components.name: PRF_GeoLocation
components.description: Traces Windows location/geolocation (time-zone auto-update, location service lfsvc, location runtime providers). At start it records the WLAN BSSIDs (netsh wlan show network mode=bssid), WLAN drivers and wireless adapters, then clears the lfsvc cache and restarts the Geolocation service. At stop it tests HTTPS reachability of the Microsoft location endpoints and collects the GeoLocation registry. Enable for wrong location, automatic time-zone, or location-service problems (Wi-Fi or cellular). Replaces NET_GeoLocation.

components.name: PRF_IME
components.description: Traces IME (Input Method Editor) and text input and collects the input/keyboard/speech registry. Enable when typing in East-Asian or other IME languages fails.

components.name: PRF_ImmersiveUI
components.description: Traces the Immersive UI (the modern full-screen shell surfaces). Enable for problems with modern UI surfaces such as the sign-in or settings experiences.

components.name: PRF_Kiosk
components.description: Traces Kiosk mode / Assigned Access and collects the Assigned Access and Shell Launcher registry. Enable when a kiosk device fails to lock to its assigned app.

components.name: PRF_LockScreen
components.description: Traces the lock screen and collects a gpresult report and registry hives. Enable when the lock screen fails to appear or misbehaves.

components.name: PRF_Media
components.description: Traces the media pipeline and Media Player. Enable when media playback fails.

components.name: PRF_Nls
components.description: Collects NLS (National Language Support - locale and region) data: exports of the relevant registry hives plus Panther and setupapi files. Enable for locale, region, or language-pack problems.

components.name: PRF_Perflib
components.description: Traces Perflib (the performance-counter library) and collects the Services and Perflib registry (32- and 64-bit). Enable when performance counters are missing, corrupt, or fail to load.

components.name: PRF_Photo
components.description: Traces the Photos app. Enable when Photos fails to launch or display images.

components.name: PRF_RADAR
components.description: Traces RADAR (Resource Exhaustion Detection and Resolution / RdrLeakDiag), the feature that detects memory leaks. Enable when investigating a suspected user-mode memory leak.

components.name: PRF_SCM
components.description: Traces the Service Control Manager (services.exe) - how Windows starts, stops, and tracks services. Enable when a service fails to start or hangs.

components.name: PRF_Search
components.description: Traces Windows Search and the search client (tquery.dll). Enable when search returns no results, is slow, or the index fails to build.

components.name: PRF_SecureBoot
components.description: Collects Secure Boot diagnostics (no ETW tracing): Secure Boot event logs, MSInfo32, the TPM task log, and Secure Boot service state. Enable when Secure Boot state or a TPM measurement is in question.

components.name: PRF_Shell
components.description: Traces the Windows shell (explorer.exe) and collects the Explorer registry, hives, and shortcut cache. The core component for taskbar, File Explorer, and desktop problems.

components.name: PRF_Shutdown
components.description: Traces shutdown. Enable to diagnose slow or hung shutdown.

components.name: PRF_Speech
components.description: Traces the Speech platform and speech apps. Enable when speech recognition or narration fails.

components.name: PRF_StartMenu
components.description: Traces the Start menu (ShellExperienceHost / StartMenuExperienceHost) and collects tile-cache, layout, and content-delivery data. Enable when the Start menu fails to open or tiles are missing.

components.name: PRF_Store
components.description: Traces the Microsoft Store app. Enable when the Store fails to open, search, or download apps.

components.name: PRF_Sysmain
components.description: Traces SysMain (SuperFetch/ReadyBoost) - the service that pre-loads frequently used apps into memory. Enable when SysMain causes high disk or memory usage.

components.name: PRF_SystemSettings
components.description: Traces the Settings app (SystemSettings.exe). Enable when the Settings app fails to open or a settings page crashes.

components.name: PRF_UWP
components.description: Traces Universal Windows Platform (UWP) apps broadly, bundling AppX, COM, Shell, and Start menu with a light WPR trace. Enable when a UWP app fails to launch or run.

components.name: PRF_WinGet
components.description: Collects Windows Package Manager (winget) diagnostics. Enable when winget fails to install, upgrade, or source packages.

components.name: PRF_WPN
components.description: Traces Windows Push Notifications (WPN) - toast and tile notifications. Enable when app notifications fail to appear.

components.name: PRF_XAML
components.description: Traces XAML and DirectComposition (dcomp) - the UI framework and compositor behind modern apps. Enable for rendering or layout problems in XAML-based apps.

components.name: SHA_ATAPort
components.description: Traces the ATA/IDE storage port driver (ataport.sys). Enable for problems with ATA/IDE-attached disks or optical drives.

components.name: SHA_CDROM
components.description: Traces the CD-ROM/DVD and UDFS (optical file system) drivers. Enable when optical drives or disc media fail to read.

components.name: SHA_CSVFS
components.description: Traces Cluster Shared Volumes File System (CSVFS) - the file system that lets all cluster nodes access the same LUN at once. Enable for CSV mount, redirected-IO, or access problems in a failover cluster.

components.name: SHA_CSVspace
components.description: Traces CSV over Storage Spaces (CSV space). Enable when Cluster Shared Volumes on Storage Spaces have IO problems.

components.name: SHA_Dedup
components.description: Traces Data Deduplication - the feature that saves space by storing duplicate file chunks once. Enable when dedup jobs fail or deduplicated files cannot be read.

components.name: SHA_FSRM
components.description: Traces File Server Resource Manager (FSRM) - quotas, file screens, and classification. Enable when quotas or file-screening rules misbehave.

components.name: SHA_HyperV
components.description: Traces Hyper-V broadly. Enable for general virtualization problems when a more specific SHA_Hyp* component is not enough.

components.name: SHA_HypVmBus
components.description: Traces the Hyper-V VMBus - the communication channel between a VM and the host. Enable when integration services or VM device communication fails.

components.name: SHA_HypVmms
components.description: Traces the Hyper-V Virtual Machine Management Service (vmms.exe). Enable when VMs fail to start, stop, or change state.

components.name: SHA_HypVmWp
components.description: Traces the Hyper-V Virtual Machine Worker Process (vmwp.exe) - the per-VM host process. Enable for problems with a specific running VM.

components.name: SHA_ISCSI
components.description: Traces the iSCSI initiator - block storage over the network. Enable when iSCSI targets fail to connect or disks disappear.

components.name: SHA_MPIO
components.description: Traces Multipath I/O (MPIO) - multiple paths to the same SAN disk for redundancy. Enable when paths fail over incorrectly or disks appear duplicated.

components.name: SHA_msDSM
components.description: Traces the Microsoft Device Specific Module (msDSM) that MPIO uses to choose paths. Enable together with SHA_MPIO for path-selection or failover-policy problems.

components.name: SHA_MSDTC
components.description: Traces the Microsoft Distributed Transaction Coordinator (MSDTC). Enable when distributed transactions fail or MSDTC cannot start.

components.name: SHA_MsCluster
components.description: Traces Failover Clustering (the cluster service). Enable for cluster formation, node join/eviction, resource failover, or quorum problems.

components.name: SHA_NFS
components.description: Traces Network File System (NFS) server and client - Unix-style file sharing. Enable when NFS mounts or exports fail.

components.name: SHA_NTFS
components.description: Traces the NTFS file system driver. Enable for NTFS corruption, access, or performance problems on local volumes.

components.name: SHA_ReFS
components.description: Traces the ReFS (Resilient File System) driver. Enable for ReFS volume mount, integrity, or performance problems (common on Storage Spaces Direct).

components.name: SHA_SDDC
components.description: Collects Software-Defined Data Center (SDDC) and cluster health via the PrivateCloud.DiagnosticInfo (Get-SDDCDiagnosticInfo) toolset. Run on a Storage Spaces Direct or failover cluster for a full health report.

components.name: SHA_ShieldedVM
components.description: Traces Shielded VMs and their Host Guardian Service integration. Enable when a shielded VM fails to start or attest.

components.name: SHA_SMS
components.description: Collects Storage Migration Service (SMS) logs via GetSmsLogs.psm1. Run on both the orchestrator node and the transfer destination node when a storage migration fails.

components.name: SHA_Storage
components.description: Broad storage trace covering the whole storage stack (aka SAN shotgun). Enable when a storage problem cannot be narrowed to a single component.

components.name: SHA_StorageSense
components.description: Traces Storage Sense - the feature that automatically frees disk space. Enable when automatic cleanup misbehaves.

components.name: SHA_StorageReplica
components.description: Traces Storage Replica - block-level volume replication between servers. Enable when replication fails or falls behind.

components.name: SHA_StorageSpace
components.description: Traces Storage Spaces - software RAID over pooled disks. Enable when a storage pool, virtual disk, or Storage Spaces Direct has problems.

components.name: SHA_Storport
components.description: Traces the Storport driver - the port driver beneath most SCSI/SAN storage adapters. Enable for disk timeout, latency, or SAN connectivity problems.

components.name: SHA_Storsvc
components.description: Traces the Storage Service (storsvc). Enable for storage-settings or Storage Sense service problems.

components.name: SHA_support-all
components.description: CollectLog-only storage/cluster/Hyper-V bundle. Runs every SHA_support-* collector except fsi, space and virtualfc: cluster, disk, mpio, dedup, vss, diskshadow, driverinfo, fltmc, fsrm, handle, iscsi, network, registry, setup, storagereplica, taskscheduler, eventlog, system (incl. msinfo32), HyperV and HyperV-detail. Output: <LogFolder>\support\<area>. Expect long runtime and large output (all event-log channels, handle.exe, recursive dir of C:\).

components.name: SHA_support-all-noHyperV
components.description: Same as SHA_support-all, but skips SHA_support-HyperV and SHA_support-HyperV-detail. Use on non-Hyper-V hosts or when Hyper-V cmdlets are slow. msinfo32 still runs.

components.name: SHA_support-all-noMsinfo
components.description: Same as SHA_support-all, but runs SHA_support-system-noMsinfo instead of SHA_support-system, so msinfo32 (slow, may hang) is skipped. Hyper-V collectors are still included.

components.name: SHA_support-cluster
components.description: Failover Cluster snapshot (skipped if clussvc.exe is absent): Get-Cluster* output for nodes, groups, resources and their parameters, networks, CSVs, quorum, affinity rules and fault domains; HKLM\Cluster as .reg and .hiv; Cluster.log, ClusterHealth.log and NetFT.log in local time; resource dependency reports; S2D storage health/debug report; SMB SBL instance, shares, sessions and witness; checksym of C:\Windows\Cluster.

components.name: SHA_support-dedup
components.description: Data Deduplication state (on Server skipped unless FS-Data-Deduplication is installed): Get-DedupStatus/Volume/Job/Schedule/Metadata (summary and detail) plus the Deduplication event logs.

components.name: SHA_support-disk
components.description: Storage stack inventory: Get-Disk/PhysicalDisk/VirtualDisk/StoragePool/StorageTier/StorageJob/Partition/Volume/StorageEnclosure/StorageFaultDomain/StorageSubsystem (summary and detail), diskpart list disk/volume/vdisk plus automount and SAN policy, mountvol, manage-bde -status (BitLocker), net session, OPENFILES and DOS device mappings.

components.name: SHA_support-diskshadow
components.description: Read-only DiskShadow output: 'list shadows all' and 'list writers detailed'. Skipped if diskshadow.exe is absent.

components.name: SHA_support-driverinfo
components.description: Driver inventory: driverquery /v (text and CSV), driverquery /si (signing status), Win32_PnPSignedDriver, and checksym file-version listings of System32 and System32\drivers.

components.name: SHA_support-eventlog
components.description: Exports ALL event-log channels except Security to EVTX, CSV and ETL (via GetEvents24.vbs). Output can be very large.

components.name: SHA_support-fltmc
components.description: File-system minifilter state: fltmc filters, volumes and instances - shows loaded (including third-party) filter drivers and their altitudes.

components.name: SHA_support-fsi
components.description: INTERACTIVE - prompts for ONE drive letter. File System Information for that volume: fsutil (ntfsinfo, sectorInfo, volumeInfo, USN journal, allocationReport, fileLayout, diskfree, thin provisioning, 8dot3name, dirty bit, quota), $Secure:$SDS metadata, compact /s, defrag /A /V (analysis only) and read-only chkdsk. Not part of SHA_support-all.

components.name: SHA_support-fsrm
components.description: File Server Resource Manager configuration (skipped if srmsvc.dll is absent): quotas and auto-quotas, file screens and exceptions, file groups, classification properties and rules, file-management jobs.

components.name: SHA_support-handle
components.description: Runs Sysinternals handle.exe -a to list all open handles of all processes. Can take several minutes and produce large output.

components.name: SHA_support-HyperV
components.description: Hyper-V host/VM inventory (skipped if vmms.exe is absent): Get-VMHost (NUMA, supported versions), migration networks, virtual switches and adapters (incl. VLAN), Get-VM with integration services, processor, snapshots, security, BIOS/firmware, Hyper-V Replica settings, and clustered VM groups.

components.name: SHA_support-HyperV-detail
components.description: Extended Hyper-V configuration report (skipped if vmms.exe is absent): detailed per-host and per-VM settings, virtual storage and network devices and related WMI data (e.g. <COMPUTERNAME>_Hyper-VBasicInfo.txt). Slower than SHA_support-HyperV on hosts with many VMs.

components.name: SHA_support-iscsi
components.description: iSCSI initiator state via iscsicli: initiators, target portals, sessions, persistent targets, target mappings and iSNS servers.

components.name: SHA_support-mpio
components.description: Multipath I/O configuration (skipped if mpclaim.exe is absent): Get-MPIOSetting, MSDSM supported/available hardware and automatic claim settings, and mpclaim -s -d for all disks and for each MPIO disk.

components.name: SHA_support-network
components.description: Broad network snapshot: ipconfig, ARP, route and netstat; Windows Firewall profiles and rules; TCP/IP dynamic and excluded port ranges; WinHTTP/WinINet proxy settings; DNS client; Get-NetAdapter* (offloads, RSS, VMQ, RDMA); SMB client; Hyper-V host networking; Network ATC; copy of System32\drivers\etc.

components.name: SHA_support-registry
components.description: Saves (.hiv) and exports (.reg) storage-relevant registry: HKLM\HARDWARE\DEVICEMAP and DESCRIPTION, HKLM\SOFTWARE (full hive), HKLM\COMPONENTS, SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet, MountedDevices, DriverDatabase, HKCR\CID, machine and user Policies, and Storage Sense settings. Large output.

components.name: SHA_support-setup
components.description: Servicing/setup data: QFE/hotfix list; CBS, DISM, WindowsServerBackup, WindowsBackup, setupcln and USOShared logs; WindowsUpdate.log, ReportingEvents.log, setupapi.*, pending.xml, poqexec.log; BITS jobs; bcdedit /enum all; DISM packages, features and intl settings; icacls of key servicing folders; service security descriptors (TrustedInstaller, wuauserv); slmgr /dlv. Also runs a recursive dir of C:\ (slow).

components.name: SHA_support-space
components.description: INTERACTIVE - prompts for ONE drive letter. Disk-space analysis for that volume: full recursive dir listings and Sysinternals du (as the user and as SYSTEM via a temporary scheduled task \TSS-SUPPORT-SPACE that is deleted at the end), fsutil statistics/storageReserve/allocation info, vssadmin shadow storage, compact, defrag analysis and read-only chkdsk. Can take very long on large volumes. Not part of SHA_support-all.

components.name: SHA_support-storagereplica
components.description: Storage Replica configuration: Get-SRGroup (incl. replicas), Get-SRPartnership, Get-SRAccess and Get-SRNetworkConstraint.

components.name: SHA_support-system
components.description: General system inventory: systeminfo, msinfo32 (.nfo, waits up to 10 min), Win32_Product, tasklist (/M, /SVC), Get-Process, Driver Verifier settings, Defender preferences, gpresult /H, Coreinfo, w32tm status/config/peers, klist, nltest /sc_verify, pnputil /export-pnpstate, Server 2012 ESU license status, and Get-WindowsFeature on Server.

components.name: SHA_support-system-noMsinfo
components.description: Same as SHA_support-system but without msinfo32. Use when msinfo32 hangs or is too slow.

components.name: SHA_support-taskscheduler
components.description: Scheduled task inventory: schtasks /query /v (text and CSV) and Get-ScheduledTask.

components.name: SHA_support-virtualfc
components.description: Fibre Channel and virtual FC (NPIV) data: fcinfo (details, ports, topology, statistics), npivtool ports and LUN mappings, HBA/NPIV WMI classes, Get-VMSan and VM Fibre Channel adapters. Not part of SHA_support-all.

components.name: SHA_support-vss
components.description: Volume Shadow Copy state: vssadmin list providers, shadows, shadowstorage, volumes and writers.

components.name: SHA_USB
components.description: Traces the USB stack. Enable when USB storage or other USB devices fail to enumerate or work.

components.name: SHA_VDS
components.description: Traces the Virtual Disk Service (VDS) - the API behind DiskPart and Disk Management. Enable when disk or volume management operations fail.

components.name: SHA_VHDMP
components.description: Traces the VHDMP driver - virtual hard disk (VHD/VHDX) mounting. Enable when VHD/VHDX files fail to attach or read.

components.name: SHA_VmConfig
components.description: Traces Hyper-V VM configuration handling. Enable when a VM's configuration fails to load or save.

components.name: SHA_VML
components.description: Traces Hyper-V Virtual Machine Live Migration (VML). Use -Mode verbose to restart the Hyper-V service and collect the FRUTI log. Enable when live migration fails or is slow.

components.name: SHA_VMM
components.description: Traces the Hyper-V VM Manager provider (VMM). Enable for Hyper-V VM management operations that fail (for System Center VMM use that product's own logs).

components.name: SHA_VSS
components.description: Traces the Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) - the snapshots used by backups. Enable when backups or shadow copies fail (for example VSS writer failures).

components.name: SHA_WSB
components.description: Traces Windows Server Backup (WSB). Enable when a Windows Server Backup job fails.

components.name: SPS_ULS
components.description: Collects SharePoint ULS (Unified Logging Service) trace logs from farm servers, with an optional time window, server list, verbosity Mode, and Merge. Parameters: [-startTime 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm' -endTime 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm' [-Servers 'server1','server2']] | [-Mode <Medium|Verbose|VerboseEx>] [-Merge]. Enable to diagnose SharePoint farm errors.

components.name: UEX_AppCompat
components.description: Traces the Application Compatibility infrastructure and UAC (User Account Control). Captures how Windows applies app-compat shims and elevation prompts, and collects the AppCompat registry and the AppCompatCache (shimcache). Enable when an app fails to run, is blocked by compatibility settings, or an elevation prompt misbehaves.

components.name: UEX_AppLocker
components.description: Traces AppLocker - the policy feature that allows or blocks apps, scripts, and installers from running. Collects the AppLocker policy files and event logs. Enable when a program is unexpectedly blocked or allowed.

components.name: UEX_AppV
components.description: Traces App-V (Application Virtualization) - the technology that streams and runs apps in isolated virtual environments. Collects the App-V registry, event logs, tasklist, gpresult, and App-V log files. Enable when a virtualized app fails to publish, launch, or update.

components.name: UEX_Auth
components.description: Traces user-experience authentication providers (the client side of sign-in and token handling used by shell and app scenarios). Enable when app or shell sign-in prompts fail.

components.name: UEX_AVDActivation
components.description: Collects AVD (Azure Virtual Desktop) Core plus activation/licensing data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on the session host (target) when AVD activation or licensing fails.

components.name: UEX_AVDAppAttach
components.description: Collects AVD Core plus MSIX App Attach data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on the session host when App Attach packages fail to mount or appear for users.

components.name: UEX_AVDAzureLocal
components.description: Collects AVD Core plus Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI) data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on the session host when AVD hosted on Azure Local has problems.

components.name: UEX_AvdCli
components.description: Traces the AVD client (the Remote Desktop app that connects to Azure Virtual Desktop). Enable on the source/client machine to capture a connection or session problem from the user side.

components.name: UEX_AVDCore
components.description: Collects the core AVD (Azure Virtual Desktop) dataset and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. The base data set that the other UEX_AVD* collectors build on; run on the session host (target).

components.name: UEX_AVDDiag
components.description: Runs the AVD diagnostics report only (no data collection or ETW tracing). Combine with UEX_AVDSource on a client, or run on a session host, for a quick health snapshot.

components.name: UEX_AVDIME
components.description: Collects AVD Core plus IME (Input Method Editor) data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on the session host when typing in East-Asian or other IME languages fails in an AVD session.

components.name: UEX_AVDMSRA
components.description: Collects AVD Core plus Remote Assistance (incl. Quick Assist and Remote Help) data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on a client (with UEX_AVDSource) or a session host when Remote Assistance/Quick Assist/Remote Help in AVD fails.

components.name: UEX_AVDProfiles
components.description: Collects AVD Core plus user-profile (FSLogix) data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on the session host when AVD user profiles fail to load or roam.

components.name: UEX_AvdRDWebRTC
components.description: Traces the AVD WebRTC redirector used for Teams media offload. Enable when Teams audio/video in an AVD session has quality or connection problems.

components.name: UEX_AVDSCard
components.description: Collects AVD Core plus smart card data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on a client (with UEX_AVDSource) or a session host when smart-card redirection in AVD fails.

components.name: UEX_AVDSource
components.description: Collects the core AVD dataset and a diagnostics report from the source/client machine - no live ETW tracing. The client-side counterpart to UEX_AVDCore.

components.name: UEX_AvdSrv
components.description: Traces the AVD server-side stack on a session host (audio, print spooler, RAIL, licensing, clipboard, device redirection, RDSH, graphics, user logon, WMI, FSLogix). Enable on the target/host to capture a session or resource-redirection problem.

components.name: UEX_AVDTeams
components.description: Collects AVD Core plus Teams data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on a client (with UEX_AVDSource) or a session host when Teams in AVD has problems.

components.name: UEX_CldFlt
components.description: Traces cldflt, the Cloud Files filter driver used by OneDrive Files On-Demand and FSLogix Cloud Cache. Enable when files fail to hydrate or sync.

components.name: UEX_CloudSync
components.description: Traces FSLogix Cloud Cache sync activity. Enable when profile containers backed by Cloud Cache fail to sync between storage providers.

components.name: UEX_COM
components.description: Traces COM/DCOM/WinRT/RPC activity - the object-activation and inter-process plumbing many apps rely on. Add -EnableCOMDebug for extra debug logging. Enable for 'class not registered', DCOM permission, or activation-timeout errors.

components.name: UEX_ContactSupport
components.description: Traces the Contact Support / Get Help app. Enable when that built-in support app fails to open or work.

components.name: UEX_CRYPT
components.description: Traces the CryptoAPI and certificate subsystem from the user-experience angle. Enable for certificate-selection or crypto errors in interactive apps.

components.name: UEX_DeviceStore
