components.description: Traces the Device Store (device metadata and container database). Enable when device names, icons, or metadata are wrong in Settings or Devices and Printers.

components.name: UEX_DSC
components.description: Collects Desired State Configuration (DSC) data by running the DSC-Collect.ps1 script. Enable when a DSC configuration fails to apply or drifts.

components.name: UEX_ESENT
components.description: Traces the ESENT (Extensible Storage Engine / Jet Blue) database engine used by many Windows components. Enable when a component backed by an ESENT database is corrupt or slow.

components.name: UEX_Evt
components.description: Traces the Windows Event Log service and collects event-log diagnostics via the Evt-Collect.ps1 script. Enable when event logging itself is failing or event subscriptions/forwarding break.

components.name: UEX_FSLogix
components.description: Traces FSLogix - the profile-container technology used by AVD and RDS. Collects frx.exe output, FSLogix logs, the FSLogix registry and profile-related hives, and group membership. Enable for profile-container mount, sign-in, or performance problems.

components.name: UEX_Fusion
components.description: Collects .NET Fusion assembly-binding logs - the details of how the .NET runtime locates and loads assemblies. Enable when a .NET app fails with assembly-load or version-binding errors.

components.name: UEX_LicenseManager
components.description: Traces the License Manager service. Enable when Windows or per-user app licensing/entitlement fails.

components.name: UEX_Logon
components.description: Traces the interactive sign-in stack: Winlogon, LogonUI, credential providers, LockApp, and Assigned Access (kiosk). Enable for sign-in, lock-screen, or kiosk-mode problems.

components.name: UEX_LSA
components.description: Traces the Local Security Authority (lsass.exe) from the UEX angle. Enable for token, security-package, or interactive-logon issues (see also ADS_LSA on Domain Controllers).

components.name: UEX_MDAG
components.description: Traces Microsoft Defender Application Guard (MDAG) - the container that isolates Edge or Office from the host. Collects Docker/WDAG event logs, the MDAG registry, and HNS load-balancer and vfpctrl port data. Enable when an Application Guard container fails to start or has network problems.

components.name: UEX_MMC
components.description: Traces the Microsoft Management Console (mmc.exe) and the .NET Fusion binding it uses to load snap-ins. Collects snap-in and .NET information. Enable when an MMC snap-in fails to load or crashes.

components.name: UEX_MMCSS
components.description: Traces the Multimedia Class Scheduler Service (MMCSS) - the service that prioritizes CPU for audio and video threads. Enable when multimedia playback stutters or audio glitches under load.

components.name: UEX_MSI
components.description: Enables verbose Windows Installer (MSI) logging and collects the resulting MSI logs and installer registry. Enable when an application install, uninstall, or repair fails.

components.name: UEX_MSRA
components.description: Traces Windows Remote Assistance (msra.exe) and screen shadowing. Enable when a Remote Assistance or shadowing session fails to connect or control the remote screen.

components.name: UEX_PowerShell
components.description: Traces PowerShell and collects a full PowerShell configuration snapshot (installed modules, repositories, PSVersionTable, providers, execution policy, profile). Enable when a script or module fails, or PowerShell behaves unexpectedly.

components.name: UEX_Print
components.description: Traces the printing stack (spooler, drivers, ports) and collects extensive printing registry, driver, and event-log data plus process dumps. The main component for print jobs failing, wrong output, or spooler crashes.

components.name: UEX_PrintCollect
components.description: Collects a static printing dataset by running the Print-Collect.ps1 script (no live ETW tracing). Use for a quick snapshot of printer configuration and logs.

components.name: UEX_QuickAssist
components.description: Traces Quick Assist (the built-in remote-help tool) together with the Edge WebView it uses. Enable when a Quick Assist session fails to start or connect.

components.name: UEX_RDSActivation
components.description: Collects RDS Core plus activation/licensing data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on a session host or RDS server when RDS licensing or activation fails.

components.name: UEX_RdsAudio
components.description: Traces RDS audio redirection. Enable when sound does not play or record correctly inside a Remote Desktop session.

components.name: UEX_RdsAuth
components.description: Traces RDS authentication (AUTH). Enable when signing in to a Remote Desktop session fails.

components.name: UEX_RdsAuthMan
components.description: Traces the RDS authentication manager (MAN-AUTH), the WMI/management view of RDS auth. Enable together with UEX_RdsAuth for management-side auth issues.

components.name: UEX_RDSrdcb
components.description: Traces the RD Connection Broker (RDBROKER) - the role that routes users to the right session host. Enable for session-placement, load-balancing, or reconnect problems.

components.name: UEX_RdsBroker
components.description: Traces the RD Connection Broker (RDBROKER) - the role that routes users to the right session host. Enable for session-placement, load-balancing, or reconnect problems.

components.name: UEX_RDScli
components.description: Traces the Remote Desktop client stack (Client, MAN-Client, Workspace). Enable on the client to capture a connection or subscription-feed problem.

components.name: UEX_RDSCore
components.description: Collects the core RDS dataset and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. The base data set the other UEX_RDS* collectors build on; run on the session host or RDS server.

components.name: UEX_RDSDiag
components.description: Runs the RDS diagnostics report only (no data collection or ETW tracing). Combine with UEX_RDSSource on a client or run on a server for a quick health snapshot.

components.name: UEX_RDSIME
components.description: Collects RDS Core plus IME (Input Method Editor) data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run when IME input fails in a Remote Desktop session.

components.name: UEX_RDSMSRA
components.description: Collects RDS Core plus Remote Assistance (incl. Quick Assist and Remote Help) data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on a client (with UEX_RDSSource) or a server for remote-help problems.

components.name: UEX_RdsMultiPoint
components.description: Traces RDS MultiPoint Services (MULTIPOINT). Enable on a MultiPoint server for station or session issues.

components.name: UEX_RdsPrintSpool
components.description: Traces the RDS print spooler (PRNTSPOOL) - redirected printing in a session. Enable when redirected printers fail in Remote Desktop.

components.name: UEX_RDSProfiles
components.description: Collects RDS Core plus user-profile (FSLogix) data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run when RDS user profiles fail to load or roam.

components.name: UEX_RdsRail
components.description: Traces RemoteApp Integrated Local (RAIL) - the protocol that makes RemoteApps look like local windows. Enable when RemoteApp window behavior, resizing, or z-order is broken.

components.name: UEX_RdsRdClient
components.description: Traces the RDS RDCLIENT engine on the client. Enable to capture the client side of a Remote Desktop connection problem.

components.name: UEX_RdsRdClientMan
components.description: Traces the RDS client management interface (MAN-RDCLIENT). Enable together with UEX_RdsRdClient for management-side client issues.

components.name: UEX_RDSrdgw
components.description: Traces the RD Gateway (RDGW) - the role that tunnels RDP over HTTPS from the internet. Enable when connections through an RD Gateway fail.

components.name: UEX_RdsRdGwMan
components.description: Traces the RD Gateway management interface (MAN-RDGW). Enable together with UEX_RdsRdGw for gateway management/WMI issues.

components.name: UEX_RdsRdms
components.description: Traces the RD Management Service (RDMS) used by Server Manager for RDS deployments. Enable when the RDS deployment console fails.

components.name: UEX_RdsRdmsMan
components.description: Traces the RDMS management interface (MAN-RDMS). Enable together with UEX_RdsRdms for RDMS WMI/management issues.

components.name: UEX_RDSrdls
components.description: Traces the RD Licensing server (LSERVER). Enable on a license server for CAL issuance or licensing-database problems.

components.name: UEX_RdsRdpClip
components.description: Traces RDP clipboard redirection (RDPCLIP). Enable when copy and paste between the local machine and the remote session fails.

components.name: UEX_RdsRdpCore
components.description: Traces the core RDP protocol engine (RDPCORE) - the heart of the Remote Desktop connection. Enable for connection drops, black screens, or protocol errors.

components.name: UEX_RdsRdpDr
components.description: Traces RDP device redirection (RDPDR) - drives, printers, and other redirected devices. Enable when redirected drives or devices are missing in a session.

components.name: UEX_RDSrdsh
components.description: Traces the Remote Desktop Session Host (RDSH) - the server that hosts user sessions. Enable for session-creation, sign-in, or resource problems on a session host.

components.name: UEX_RdsRdshMan
components.description: Traces the RDSH management interface (MAN-RDSH). Enable together with UEX_RdsRdsh for session-host WMI/management issues.

components.name: UEX_RDSrdwa
components.description: Traces the Remote Desktop Web Access (RDWA) - the server that provides web-based access to RemoteApp and Desktop Connection. Enable for web access issues.

components.name: UEX_RDSSCard
components.description: Collects RDS Core plus smart card data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on a client (with UEX_RDSSource) or a server when smart-card redirection fails.

components.name: UEX_RDSSource
components.description: Collects the core RDS dataset and a diagnostics report from the source/client machine - no live ETW tracing. The client-side counterpart to UEX_RDSCore.

components.name: UEX_RDSsrv
components.description: Traces the full RDS server-side stack on a session host or RDS server (RemoteApp, audio, Hyper-V, MultiPoint, print, broker, gateway, RDMS, licensing, clipboard, device redirection, RDSH, graphics, user logon, VM agent, WMI, FSLogix). The broad server-side switch for RDS problems.

components.name: UEX_RDSTeams
components.description: Collects RDS Core plus Teams data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on a client (with UEX_RDSSource) or a server for Teams-in-RDS problems.

components.name: UEX_RdsUsrLogon
components.description: Traces RDS user logon (USRLOGON) - the per-user session setup. Enable for slow or failing sign-in to a session host.

components.name: UEX_RdsUsrLogonMan
components.description: Traces the RDS user-logon management interface (MAN-USRLOGON). Enable together with UEX_RdsUsrLogon for logon management issues.

components.name: UEX_RdsVip
components.description: Traces RDS VIP (virtual IP) redirection. Enable when per-session IP virtualization misbehaves.

components.name: UEX_RdsWrkspc
components.description: Traces the RDS Workspace (WRKSPC) - the feed of published resources shown to users. Enable when the RemoteApp and Desktop feed fails to update.

components.name: UEX_RDWebRTC
components.description: Traces the RD WebRTC redirector for Teams media offload in RDS. Enable when Teams audio/video quality in an RDS session is poor.

components.name: UEX_RestartManager
components.description: Traces the Restart Manager - the service that lets installers close and restart apps holding files. Enable when installs or updates hang asking to close applications.

components.name: UEX_Sched
components.description: Deprecated - use UEX_TSched instead. Traces the Task Scheduler.

components.name: UEX_ServerManager
components.description: Traces Server Manager (ServerManager.exe) together with WinRM and WMI, which it relies on. Enable when Server Manager fails to query or manage servers.

components.name: UEX_Telemetry
components.description: Traces the Windows telemetry / diagnostics-data pipeline and collects the telemetry registry, AppCompat data, and SCCM client version. Enable when diagnostic data or Update-related telemetry is not flowing.

components.name: UEX_TSched
components.description: Traces the Task Scheduler and collects scheduler data via the Sched-Collect.ps1 script (tasks, event logs, registry). Enable when a scheduled task fails to run or triggers incorrectly.

components.name: UEX_UEV
components.description: Traces UE-V (User Experience Virtualization) - roaming of app and OS settings. Collects the UE-V registry, tasks, templates, and packages. Enable when settings fail to roam between machines.

components.name: UEX_UserDataAccess
components.description: Traces User Data Access - the platform behind Contacts, Calendar, and Messaging data access. Enable when apps cannot read user data such as contacts or calendar.

components.name: UEX_VAN
components.description: Traces the View Available Networks (VAN) flyout - the network list UI. Enable when the network or Wi-Fi list fails to display.

components.name: UEX_W365Activation
components.description: Collects W365 (Windows 365 Cloud PC) Core plus activation/licensing data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on the W365 Cloud PC (target) when OS activation or licensing fails.

components.name: UEX_W365cli
components.description: Traces the W365 client (the Remote Desktop app that connects to Windows 365 Cloud PC). Enable on the source/client machine to capture a connection or session problem from the user side.

components.name: UEX_W365Core
components.description: Collects the core W365 (Windows 365 Cloud PC) dataset and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. The base data set that the other UEX_W365* collectors build on; run on the W365 Cloud PC (target).

components.name: UEX_W365Diag
components.description: Runs the W365 diagnostics report only (no data collection or ETW tracing). Combine with UEX_W365Source on a client, or run on a W365 Cloud PC (target), for a quick health snapshot.

components.name: UEX_W365IME
components.description: Collects W365 Core plus IME (Input Method Editor) data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on the session host when typing in East-Asian or other IME languages fails in a W365 Cloud PC session.

components.name: UEX_W365MSRA
components.description: Collects W365 Core plus Remote Assistance (incl. Quick Assist and Remote Help) data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on a client (with UEX_W365Source) or a session host when Remote Assistance/Quick Assist/Remote Help in a W365 Cloud PC session fails.

components.name: UEX_W365Profiles
components.description: Collects W365 Core plus user-profile data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on the W365 Cloud PC when user profiles fail to load or roam.

components.name: UEX_W365SCard
components.description: Collects W365 Core plus smart card data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on a client (with UEX_W365Source) or a W365 Cloud PC when smart-card redirection in the remote session fails.

components.name: UEX_W365Source
components.description: Collects the core W365 dataset and a diagnostics report from the source/client machine - no live ETW tracing. The client-side counterpart to UEX_W365Core.

components.name: UEX_W365srv
components.description: Traces the W365 server-side stack on a W365 Cloud PC (audio, print spooler, RAIL, licensing, clipboard, device redirection, RDSH, graphics, user logon, WMI). Enable on the target/host to capture a session or resource-redirection problem.

components.name: UEX_W365Teams
components.description: Collects W365 Core plus Teams data and a diagnostics report - no live ETW tracing. Run on a client (with UEX_W365Source) or a W365 Cloud PC when Teams in W365 has problems.

components.name: UEX_Webview
components.description: Traces the Edge WebView2 runtime that hosts web content inside apps. Enable when an app's embedded web content fails to load (often used with Quick Assist).

components.name: UEX_WER
components.description: Traces Windows Error Reporting (WER). Enable when crash reporting, dumps, or the problem-reporting UI fail.

components.name: UEX_Win32k
components.description: Traces Win32k - the kernel-mode window manager and GDI. Enable for window, input, or graphics-subsystem problems in interactive sessions.

components.name: UEX_WinRMBase
components.description: Traces Windows Remote Management (WinRM) at a basic level and collects WinRM diagnostics via WinRM-Collect.ps1. Enable for most remote-management and PowerShell-remoting connection problems.

components.name: UEX_WinRMAdvanced
components.description: Traces Windows Remote Management (WinRM) at an advanced level (covers most WinRM scenarios) and collects WinRM diagnostics. Use when UEX_WinRMBase is not detailed enough.

components.name: UEX_WMIBase
components.description: Traces WMI (winmgmt) at a basic level and collects WMI diagnostics via WMI-Collect.ps1. Optional -WMIProvList narrows to specific providers (Cluster, Storage, DCOM, RPC, MDM, Perf, RDMS, RDSPub). Enable for WMI query failures.

components.name: UEX_WMIAdvanced
components.description: Traces WMI (winmgmt) at an advanced level and collects WMI diagnostics. Optional -WMIProvList narrows to specific providers. Use when UEX_WMIBase is not detailed enough, for example for provider crashes or high CPU.

components.name: UEX_WMIReport
components.description: Exports a report of the WMI repository objects (classes and instances) via WMI-Report.ps1 - no live tracing. Use to inspect or compare WMI repository content.

components.name: UEX_WSC
components.description: Traces the Windows Security Center (WSC) service - the component that reports antivirus and firewall health. Enable when security status is reported incorrectly.

components.name: UEX_WVD
components.description: Deprecated - use UEX_AvdCli (client) or UEX_AvdSrv (session host) instead. Traces Azure Virtual Desktop.

components.name: WIN_kernel
components.description: Runs a Windows Kernel trace (the NT Kernel Logger - CPU, disk, memory, and process/thread events). Only one NT Kernel Logger can run at a time, so this is incompatible with Xperf.

components.name: WIN_CustomETL
components.description: user provided component ETW tracing; -CustomETL holds the list of comma separated, quoted `"{GUID}`" and/or `"Provider-Name`"s. The log will be stored in XXX_WIN_CustomETLTrace.etl.

collectLogs.name: ADS_AccountLockout

collectLogs.name: ADS_ADDS
collectLogs.description: Collects Active Directory Domain Services static data: Kerberos tickets (klist), stored credentials (cmdkey), tasklist, the LSA/Netlogon/Winlogon/ProfSvc/Policies registry hives, policy definitions, and the adprep/dcpromo/netlogon/netsetup logs.

collectLogs.name: ADS_ADLDS
collectLogs.description: Collects AD LDS (Lightweight Directory Services / ADAM) static data: each ADAM instance configuration, certutil output, dcdiag, ldifde exports, whoami, gpresult, and the AD LDS event logs.

collectLogs.name: ADS_ADWS

collectLogs.name: ADS_EFS

collectLogs.name: ADS_Netlogon

collectLogs.description: Collects a broad setup/deployment report suitable for most DND investigations: system and DISM state, storage, BitLocker, services, registry hives, setup/update/deployment logs, USO and Delivery Optimization (DO) context, reliability, Defender, MDM, WinRE, and secure-boot context.

collectLogs.name: DND_USB
collectLogs.description: Collects USB static data: device/driver enumeration, USB registry and event logs, build and power context, and sleep-study output (with text fallback when sleep-study HTML is unavailable).

collectLogs.description: Collects Windows Update static data and mirrors CopyLogs-style evidence: update history, CBS/DISM and servicing artifacts, WSUS and Delivery Optimization (DO) policy/tasks, USO logs, upgrade/Panther logs, and Windows Update logs.

collectLogs.name: DND_WUfBReport
collectLogs.description: Collects a Windows Update for Business report: DataCollection/DiagTrack registry, scheduled tasks, dsregcmd device state, and diagtrack version info.

collectLogs.name: INT_MSMQ
collectLogs.description: Collects Microsoft Message Queuing (MSMQ) static data: MSMQ configuration, registry, queues, and event logs.

collectLogs.name: ITN_Report
collectLogs.description: Collects Microsoft Intune device management (MDM) diagnostics: enrollment/MDM/IME state, Autopilot, registry, event logs, Intune client logs, and WinGet deployment logs from system and current-user contexts (separate from ConfigMgr/MCM). Also runs a Windows Update / WUfB health check (WSUS, dual scan, scan source policy, telemetry, Device Health Monitoring (DHM), Update Health Tools (uhssvc), deployment service (DSS) cloud processing, safeguard holds, metered connection, pending reboot) and collects Windows Update data: update history, Microsoft.Update.ServiceManager registrations, WU/WUfB registry keys, Update Health Tools/DISM/USO/SoftwareDistribution ReportingEvents logs, and MDM dmmap WMI policy results gathered in SYSTEM context. Collects Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) data as well: the agent logs, install and service state, DeviceHealthMonitoring and PrivilegeManagement registry values, EnterpriseMgmt enrollment task GUIDs, a 4022/4023 event extract, the Sensor.log reporting markers, and elevation rule / client settings snapshots taken through the EpmTools cmdlets, plus 13 EPM health checks. The Intune/MDM/enrollment event channels are exported as .evtx into the report's own 09_EventLogs folder, using the same channel set as Intune One Data Collector (MDM enrollment/sync/inventory, AAD and device registration, Autopilot and provisioning, app deployment and Store, Defender/MDE/BitLocker/WDAC/AppLocker/LAPS policy, kiosk and shell, Windows Update, telemetry, BITS), alongside a <Computer>_EventLog_Inventory.txt that lists every requested channel with its status, record count and size. A 10_BitLocker folder covers device encryption: per-volume protection and conversion state, key protector types (recovery passwords are deliberately not collected), TPM and Secure Boot state, the BitLocker CSP / FVE / Control\BitLocker registry, and Device Health Attestation client state. Policy data covers the resolved CSP policy, the ADMX landing zone under SOFTWARE\Policies, Declared Configuration, the ingested ADMX templates, and a generated <Computer>_PolicySummary.txt listing the enrollment providers, their native CSP versus ADMX-backed areas and any setting won by a different provider. The 11_Certificates folder inventories all accessible LocalMachine and CurrentUser certificate stores in TXT and CSV, including issuer, thumbprint, validity, EKU and private-key presence but never exporting private keys or PFX files. CurrentUser is the account running TSS, not every user profile. The 12_Services folder lists all Windows services returned by Win32_Service with runtime State, configured StartMode, process ID, binary path and logon account in TXT and CSV, including dmwappushservice when installed. Both inventories run by default without requiring Full BasicLog. Output is grouped into scenario folders with a generated _ReadMe.txt, and failed or warning checks are summarized in <Computer>___KnownIssues.txt.

collectLogs.name: ITN_CertConnector
collectLogs.description: Server-side collector for the Certificate Connector for Microsoft Intune and the NDES role; run it on the connector server, not on a managed client (use ITN_Report for that). Collects connector configuration and registry, connector and IIS logs, connector setup/install/upgrade logs from both the static %windir%\Microsoft Intune\CertificateConnectorSetup folder and the temporary folders a failed install falls back to, NDES/IIS role state and the SCEP application pool, MSCEP and HTTP.sys registry values, certificate stores, and the Intune Certificate Connector and AzureADConnect agent updater event channels. Also runs 47 rule-based checks ported from the IntuneCertificateConnectorDiagnostics module, including active validation of the network path the connector uses at startup: DNS, proxy CONNECT, TCP, TLS 1.2 handshake and chain trust, TLS-interception detection, CRL/OCSP reachability, the service-locator call, and the auto-update endpoint. The expensive probes run concurrently in the framework runspace pool. Failed or warning checks are summarized in <Computer>___KnownIssues.txt, and a generated _ReadMe.txt explains each output folder.

collectLogs.name: MCM_Report
collectLogs.description: Collects a full Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) client report: client logs, configuration, registry, and status. Also collects Configuration Manager Site Server/System configuration and logs, WSUS, IIS, and SQL configuration, and Windows Update Agent and Delivery Optimization logs and configuration.

collectLogs.description: Collects wired 802.1x (dot3) static diagnostics: 802.1x/TLS/WinHTTP and .NET Framework registry, dot3svc policy files, 802.1x/wireless event logs, netsh wlan report (wlan-report-latest.html) and Credential Guard/Device Guard state. Recommended via -Scenario NET_802Dot1x.

collectLogs.name: NET_BFE
collectLogs.description: Collects Base Filtering Engine (BFE) static diagnostics: BFE service and registry (ACL) permissions. Typically used with -Scenario NET_Firewall or NET_WFP.

collectLogs.name: NET_BITs
collectLogs.description: Collects Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) static diagnostics: BITS and NLA/NCSI registry, copies the verbose BITS.log files from System32, and the Bits-Client/Operational event log.

collectLogs.name: NET_Bluetooth
collectLogs.description: Collects Bluetooth static diagnostics: Bluetooth registry and event logs, plus radio information via the tss_GetBluetoothRadioInfo.ps1 script (resets the earlier VerboseOn registry setting).

collectLogs.name: NET_BranchCache
collectLogs.description: Collects BranchCache static diagnostics: BranchCache and TCP registry, BranchCache operational/analytic event logs and GPresult.

collectLogs.name: NET_Container
collectLogs.description: Collects Windows container / Docker / Kubernetes networking static diagnostics: HNS registry and event logs, firewall rules/profiles and their log files, WFP state/filters, plus a docker (info, network ls, ps, service/node) or kubectl (pods, nodes, services) inventory and recent Docker application events.

collectLogs.name: NET_CSC
collectLogs.description: Collects Offline Files / Client-Side Caching (CSC) static diagnostics: CSC/SMB/Defender-ATP registry, CSC event logs and GPresult.

collectLogs.name: NET_DAcli
collectLogs.description: Collects DirectAccess client static diagnostics: runs the tss_DAclient-collector.ps1 script, gathers DA/NCSI client config and IPv6 transition config (Get-DAConnectionStatus, Get-DAClientExperienceConfiguration, Get-NetIPHTTPSConfiguration, Get-NetTeredoState), netsh DA output, DA client event logs and GPresult.

collectLogs.name: NET_DAsrv
collectLogs.description: Collects DirectAccess server static diagnostics: netsh ras dump, IP-HTTPS state, dynamic port range, DA/LDAPcli/TLS/WinHTTP and .NET registry, Get-DAServer / Get-RemoteAccess / Get-RemoteAccessHealth / Get-DAEntryPointDC output, and DA server event logs.

collectLogs.name: NET_DFSsrv
collectLogs.description: Collects DFS Namespace server static diagnostics: DFS and RPC registry and DFS server event logs.

collectLogs.name: NET_DHCPcli
collectLogs.description: Collects DHCP client static diagnostics: DHCPcli and TCP registry and the DHCP-Client event logs.

collectLogs.name: NET_DHCPsrv
collectLogs.description: Collects DHCP server static diagnostics: DHCP registry, DHCP server event logs, netsh dhcp server show output, Get-DhcpServer* PowerShell config, the DHCP database and audit logs, and AccessChk permissions on the DHCP logs.

collectLogs.name: NET_DNScli
collectLogs.description: Collects DNS client static diagnostics: Auth/Crypt/TLS/WinHTTP and .NET registry and the DNS-Client/Operational event log.

collectLogs.name: NET_DNSsrv
collectLogs.description: Collects DNS server static diagnostics: DNS server registry and DNS server event logs. (Full config/statistics are gathered by the NET_DNSsrv component/scenario.)

collectLogs.name: NET_Firewall
collectLogs.description: Collects Windows Defender Firewall static diagnostics: firewall registry, firewall and Security event logs, and netsh advfirewall show output (also toggles current-profile connection logging).

collectLogs.name: NET_HttpSys
collectLogs.description: Collects HTTP.sys static diagnostics: the CAPI2/Operational event log. (HTTP URL ACLs and config are gathered by the related IIS scenarios.)

collectLogs.name: NET_HypHost
collectLogs.description: Collects Hyper-V host networking static diagnostics: Hyper-V host and SMB client event logs, HyperV registry, and the Hyper-V host config (Get-VMHost exported to XML).

collectLogs.name: NET_HypVM
collectLogs.description: Collects Hyper-V guest (VM) networking static diagnostics: the Hyper-V-NETVSC/Diagnostic event log.

collectLogs.name: NET_ICS
collectLogs.description: Collects Internet Connection Sharing (ICS / SharedAccess-NAT) static diagnostics: ICS registry.

collectLogs.name: NET_IIS
collectLogs.description: Collects IIS server static diagnostics: HTTPERR and inetpub log files, netsh http show output, appcmd site/app-pool/app config (incl. XML), and HTTP/TLS/WinHTTP and .NET registry.

collectLogs.name: NET_IPAM
collectLogs.description: Collects IP Address Management (IPAM) static diagnostics: IPAM event logs and .svclog files, and converts any IPAM.etl to text (resets IPAM debug registry to default).

collectLogs.name: NET_IPhlpSvc
collectLogs.description: Collects IP Helper service (IpHlpSvc) static diagnostics: IpHlpSvc registry and the resulting Windows tracing logs.

collectLogs.name: NET_IPsec
collectLogs.description: Collects IPsec static diagnostics: the Security event log (IPsec / Filtering-Platform auditing). IPsec rules are gathered by the NET_IPsec component/scenario.

collectLogs.name: NET_LBFO
collectLogs.description: Collects NIC Teaming (LBFO) static diagnostics: LBFO registry and teaming/certificate info.

collectLogs.name: NET_LLTDIO
collectLogs.description: Collects Link-Layer Topology Discovery (LLTDIO) static diagnostics: GPresult /Z output.

collectLogs.name: NET_MBAM
collectLogs.description: Collects Microsoft BitLocker Administration and Monitoring (MBAM) static diagnostics: Auth/Crypt/TLS/WinHTTP and .NET registry and MBAM event logs.

collectLogs.name: NET_MBN
collectLogs.description: Collects Mobile Broadband (MBN/WWAN) static diagnostics: WMI logs and WwanSvc profiles, 802.1x/MBN/TCP/TLS/WinHTTP registry and MBN event logs.

collectLogs.name: NET_MDM
collectLogs.description: Collects Mobile Device Management (MDM) static diagnostics: runs MdmDiagnosticsTool, MDM registry and the DeviceManagement admin/analytic event logs.

collectLogs.name: NET_MFAext
collectLogs.description: Collects Azure MFA NPS Extension static diagnostics: MFAext registry, MFAext/System/NPS event logs, and an NPS-filtered event export.

collectLogs.name: NET_Miracast
collectLogs.description: Collects Miracast / Wi-Fi Direct static diagnostics: 802.1x/Miracast/Firewall registry, 802.1x event logs, netsh wlan show driver output and GPresult.

collectLogs.name: NET_NCSI
collectLogs.description: Collects Network Connectivity Status Indicator (NCSI/NLA) static diagnostics: NLA/NCSI and LDAPcli registry, NCSI/NLA and Security event logs, proxy info and GPresult.

collectLogs.name: NET_Netlogon
collectLogs.description: Collects Netlogon static diagnostics: copies the Windows debug folder (netlogon.log).

collectLogs.name: NET_Netsetup
collectLogs.description: Collects domain-join / network-setup static diagnostics: copies the Windows logs NetSetup folder.

collectLogs.name: NET_NFScli

collectLogs.name: NET_NFSsrv

collectLogs.name: NET_NLB
collectLogs.description: Collects Network Load Balancing (NLB) static diagnostics: msinfo32, the NLB/Diagnostic event log, WLBS registry, WLBS display and ARP table.

collectLogs.name: NET_NPS
collectLogs.description: Collects Network Policy Server (NPS/RADIUS) static diagnostics: NPS/RAS/LDAPcli/TLS/WinHTTP registry, netsh nps show config and export (with PSK), and the NPS log files.

collectLogs.name: NET_OpenSSH

collectLogs.name: NET_PortProxy

collectLogs.name: NET_Proxy

collectLogs.name: NET_RAS
collectLogs.description: Collects Remote Access Server (RAS / VPN server) static diagnostics: netsh ras dump, RAS event logs, RAS/LDAPcli/TLS/WinHTTP registry and AlwaysOn VPN Get-VpnAuthProtocol output.

collectLogs.name: NET_RDMA

collectLogs.name: NET_RPC

collectLogs.name: NET_SCCM

collectLogs.name: PRF_Cortana
collectLogs.description: Collects Cortana static data: the Cortana and Windows Search policy registry.

collectLogs.name: PRF_Font

collectLogs.name: PRF_GeoLocation

collectLogs.name: PRF_IME

collectLogs.name: PRF_Kiosk

collectLogs.name: PRF_Nls

collectLogs.name: PRF_Perflib
collectLogs.description: Collects performance-counter library static data: the Services and Perflib registry (32- and 64-bit) exported as text, .hiv, and .reg.

collectLogs.name: PRF_SecureBoot
collectLogs.description: Collects Secure Boot static data: Secure Boot event logs, MSInfo32, the TPM task log, and Secure Boot service state.

collectLogs.name: PRF_Shell
collectLogs.description: Collects shell static data: the HKCU and HKLM Explorer registry hives, the ARCache, and program shortcut files.

collectLogs.name: PRF_StartMenu
collectLogs.description: Collects Start menu static data: the tile cache (via datastorecachedumptool), DataLayerState, default layout, Content Delivery Manager data, ARCache, and program shortcuts.

collectLogs.name: PRF_WinGet
collectLogs.description: Collects Windows Package Manager (winget) static data: winget command output and deployment logs.

collectLogs.name: SHA_HypHost
collectLogs.description: Collects Hyper-V host static data: the Hyper-V and SMB-client event logs, the HyperV registry, physical and VM network adapter details, and an export of the host's Hyper-V configuration (including the data.vmcx files).

collectLogs.name: SHA_HypVM
collectLogs.description: Collects Hyper-V guest static data: the Hyper-V NETVSC (synthetic network) diagnostic event log.

collectLogs.name: SHA_MSDTC
collectLogs.description: Collects MSDTC static data: the MSDTC registry settings (and disables the service traces and restarts the MSDTC service on stop).

collectLogs.name: SHA_SDDC
collectLogs.description: Collects Storage Spaces Direct / cluster health by running GetSddcDiagnosticInfo.ps1 (PrivateCloud.DiagnosticInfo) and a SpaceDB Chkspace check.

collectLogs.name: SHA_ShieldedVM
collectLogs.description: Collects Shielded VM static data: the shielded-VM and Host Guardian Service event logs and related command output.

collectLogs.name: SHA_Sms
collectLogs.description: Collects Storage Migration Service logs by running GetSmsLogs.psm1 (Server SKU only). Run on both the orchestrator and transfer-destination nodes.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-all
collectLogs.description: CollectLog-only storage/cluster/Hyper-V bundle. Runs every SHA_support-* collector except fsi, space and virtualfc: cluster, disk, mpio, dedup, vss, diskshadow, driverinfo, fltmc, fsrm, handle, iscsi, network, registry, setup, storagereplica, taskscheduler, eventlog, system (incl. msinfo32), HyperV and HyperV-detail. Output: <LogFolder>\support\<area>. Expect long runtime and large output (all event-log channels, handle.exe, recursive dir of C:\).

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-all-noHyperV
collectLogs.description: Same as SHA_support-all, but skips SHA_support-HyperV and SHA_support-HyperV-detail. Use on non-Hyper-V hosts or when Hyper-V cmdlets are slow. msinfo32 still runs.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-all-noMsinfo
collectLogs.description: Same as SHA_support-all, but runs SHA_support-system-noMsinfo instead of SHA_support-system, so msinfo32 (slow, may hang) is skipped. Hyper-V collectors are still included.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-cluster
collectLogs.description: Failover Cluster snapshot (skipped if clussvc.exe is absent): Get-Cluster* output for nodes, groups, resources and their parameters, networks, CSVs, quorum, affinity rules and fault domains; HKLM\Cluster as .reg and .hiv; Cluster.log, ClusterHealth.log and NetFT.log in local time; resource dependency reports; S2D storage health/debug report; SMB SBL instance, shares, sessions and witness; checksym of C:\Windows\Cluster.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-dedup
collectLogs.description: Data Deduplication state (on Server skipped unless FS-Data-Deduplication is installed): Get-DedupStatus/Volume/Job/Schedule/Metadata (summary and detail) plus the Deduplication event logs.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-disk
collectLogs.description: Storage stack inventory: Get-Disk/PhysicalDisk/VirtualDisk/StoragePool/StorageTier/StorageJob/Partition/Volume/StorageEnclosure/StorageFaultDomain/StorageSubsystem (summary and detail), diskpart list disk/volume/vdisk plus automount and SAN policy, mountvol, manage-bde -status (BitLocker), net session, OPENFILES and DOS device mappings.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-diskshadow
collectLogs.description: Read-only DiskShadow output: 'list shadows all' and 'list writers detailed'. Skipped if diskshadow.exe is absent.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-driverinfo
collectLogs.description: Driver inventory: driverquery /v (text and CSV), driverquery /si (signing status), Win32_PnPSignedDriver, and checksym file-version listings of System32 and System32\drivers.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-eventlog
collectLogs.description: Exports ALL event-log channels except Security to EVTX, CSV and ETL (via GetEvents24.vbs). Output can be very large.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-fltmc
collectLogs.description: File-system minifilter state: fltmc filters, volumes and instances - shows loaded (including third-party) filter drivers and their altitudes.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-fsi
collectLogs.description: INTERACTIVE - prompts for ONE drive letter. File System Information for that volume: fsutil (ntfsinfo, sectorInfo, volumeInfo, USN journal, allocationReport, fileLayout, diskfree, thin provisioning, 8dot3name, dirty bit, quota), $Secure:$SDS metadata, compact /s, defrag /A /V (analysis only) and read-only chkdsk. Not part of SHA_support-all.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-fsrm
collectLogs.description: File Server Resource Manager configuration (skipped if srmsvc.dll is absent): quotas and auto-quotas, file screens and exceptions, file groups, classification properties and rules, file-management jobs.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-handle
collectLogs.description: Runs Sysinternals handle.exe -a to list all open handles of all processes. Can take several minutes and produce large output.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-HyperV
collectLogs.description: Hyper-V host/VM inventory (skipped if vmms.exe is absent): Get-VMHost (NUMA, supported versions), migration networks, virtual switches and adapters (incl. VLAN), Get-VM with integration services, processor, snapshots, security, BIOS/firmware, Hyper-V Replica settings, and clustered VM groups.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-HyperV-detail
collectLogs.description: Extended Hyper-V configuration report (skipped if vmms.exe is absent): detailed per-host and per-VM settings, virtual storage and network devices and related WMI data (e.g. <COMPUTERNAME>_Hyper-VBasicInfo.txt). Slower than SHA_support-HyperV on hosts with many VMs.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-iscsi
collectLogs.description: iSCSI initiator state via iscsicli: initiators, target portals, sessions, persistent targets, target mappings and iSNS servers.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-mpio
collectLogs.description: Multipath I/O configuration (skipped if mpclaim.exe is absent): Get-MPIOSetting, MSDSM supported/available hardware and automatic claim settings, and mpclaim -s -d for all disks and for each MPIO disk.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-network
collectLogs.description: Broad network snapshot: ipconfig, ARP, route and netstat; Windows Firewall profiles and rules; TCP/IP dynamic and excluded port ranges; WinHTTP/WinINet proxy settings; DNS client; Get-NetAdapter* (offloads, RSS, VMQ, RDMA); SMB client; Hyper-V host networking; Network ATC; copy of System32\drivers\etc.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-registry
collectLogs.description: Saves (.hiv) and exports (.reg) storage-relevant registry: HKLM\HARDWARE\DEVICEMAP and DESCRIPTION, HKLM\SOFTWARE (full hive), HKLM\COMPONENTS, SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet, MountedDevices, DriverDatabase, HKCR\CID, machine and user Policies, and Storage Sense settings. Large output.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-setup
collectLogs.description: Servicing/setup data: QFE/hotfix list; CBS, DISM, WindowsServerBackup, WindowsBackup, setupcln and USOShared logs; WindowsUpdate.log, ReportingEvents.log, setupapi.*, pending.xml, poqexec.log; BITS jobs; bcdedit /enum all; DISM packages, features and intl settings; icacls of key servicing folders; service security descriptors (TrustedInstaller, wuauserv); slmgr /dlv. Also runs a recursive dir of C:\ (slow).

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-space
collectLogs.description: INTERACTIVE - prompts for ONE drive letter. Disk-space analysis for that volume: full recursive dir listings and Sysinternals du (as the user and as SYSTEM via a temporary scheduled task \TSS-SUPPORT-SPACE that is deleted at the end), fsutil statistics/storageReserve/allocation info, vssadmin shadow storage, compact, defrag analysis and read-only chkdsk. Can take very long on large volumes. Not part of SHA_support-all.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-storagereplica

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-system

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-system-noMsinfo
collectLogs.description: Same as SHA_support-system but without msinfo32. Use when msinfo32 hangs or is too slow.

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-taskscheduler

collectLogs.name: SHA_support-virtualfc
